clean_body: Tricia Ciccone Wants to Bring Local Priorities Back to Hartford | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more The Goldstein Substack - A Father-Son Publication Dr. Goldstein is Running for Congress and his page can be found Tricia Ciccone Wants to Bring Local Priorities Back to Hartford | | | Jun 29 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- For too long, many residents of Norwalk have felt that decisions affecting their neighborhoods, schools, businesses, and families are being made without enough input from the people who actually live there. That is why Tricia Ciccone is running to represent Connecticut's 137th Assembly District in Norwalk. A longtime Norwalk resident, community volunteer, mother, and education professional, Ciccone is building her campaign around a simple idea: government in Hartford should listen to the people of Norwalk--not the other way around. " Norwalk is not just where I live," Ciccone told supporters at her campaign kickoff. "It's my home. It's where I raised my family. It's where I work. It's where I volunteer." Having spent years working with children and families through educational and after-school programs while raising her own family in Norwalk, Ciccone says she understands both the strengths of the community and the challenges residents face every day. () Putting Norwalk First Throughout her campaign kickoff, one message remained constant: Norwalk deserves to have its own voice. "I want to make sure we're putting our community first," she said. "Norwalk residents need to be heard." For Ciccone, that means reversing what she sees as a growing disconnect between Hartford and local communities. "The decisions affecting Norwalk should be guided by its residents--not the other way around," she said. "Hartford shouldn't be telling us what Norwalk needs. The people who live here know our community best." That commitment to local control has become one of the defining themes of her campaign. Fighting for Affordability Like many Connecticut candidates this year, Ciccone says affordability is the issue she hears about most often from voters. Families are struggling with rising costs. Seniors are worried about remaining in the communities they helped build. Taxpayers want greater transparency and confidence that their money is being spent wisely. "I know families are feeling the pressure of rising prices," Ciccone said. "I know seniors are looking at affordability. I know taxpayers want transparency and a government that works for them." Her priorities include lowering energy costs, protecting taxpayers, supporting responsible budgeting, and creating a more affordable Connecticut for working families and retirees. () Modernizing Education Funding As someone who has spent her professional career working with children and families, education is central to Ciccone's campaign. She believes Connecticut 's current Education Cost Sharing (ECS) formula no longer reflects Norwalk's needs. Rather than relying primarily on property values, she argues that education funding should better account for multilingual learners, special education needs, and the real costs school districts face today. "Our schools deserve funding based on the needs of our students," she said. Her campaign calls for modernizing the ECS formula, increasing support for special education, and reducing the pressure local education costs place on property taxpayers. () Restoring Local Control Ciccone also expressed concern about state policies that reduce local decision-making. She pointed to recent housing legislation that, in her view, limits municipal authority over planning and development. Norwalk, she argues, should be able to make decisions that reflect its own infrastructure, neighborhoods, and transportation needs. "Local communities know what's best for their own future," she said. Supporting Public Safety and Small Businesses Ciccone says supporting first responders and strengthening public safety must remain priorities. Police officers, firefighters, EMTs, and emergency personnel should have the resources necessary to protect the community without uncertainty over funding, she said. She also believes Norwalk's small businesses deserve greater support. "Our businesses are the backbone of our community," Ciccone said. "We need to support the businesses we already have while creating an environment where new businesses want to invest in Norwalk." A Campaign Built on Listening Perhaps the most recurring theme throughout Ciccone's remarks was listening. She promised voters that if elected, she would spend her time in neighborhoods across the district hearing directly from residents. "My goal is to earn your trust," she said. "To be ethical. To listen. Because I don't think people feel like they're being listened to." She emphasized that regardless of political affiliation, most residents share the same goals: Affordable living. Strong public schools. Safe neighborhoods. Lower energy costs. Responsible government. Those are the priorities she says will guide her work in Hartford. Building a Team for Change Ciccone also reminded supporters that campaigns are never about one person. She encouraged volunteers to knock on doors, make phone calls, and help neighbors participate in the election. She also highlighted fellow Republican State Senate candidate Justin Perry and Congressional candidate Dr. Michael Goldstein emphasizing that building better representation for Norwalk requires electing strong candidates throughout the entire ballot. " This is a team effort," she told supporters. "None of us can do this alone." Ciccone's message reflects a broader effort among Republican candidates across Fairfield County to work together, support one another, and offer voters alternatives at every level of government. A Choice for the 137th District Tricia Ciccone believes Norwalk deserves a representative who knows the community because she has lived it. As a mother, educator, volunteer, and longtime resident, she says she understands both the opportunities and challenges facing local families. Her campaign is built around practical leadership, fiscal responsibility, local control, improving education funding, reducing energy costs, supporting small businesses, and making government more accountable to the people it serves. As the **highest-ranking Black Republican elected official in Mississippi** , Rodney Hall has earned a reputation as a principled conservative who has consistently fought for secure borders, strong families, and limited government. Peter,
At 9 PM on Saturday night we declared victory in our runoff to become the Democratic Nominee for US Senate in Louisiana with a commanding 79.9% of the vote and a clean sweep of every single parish (county) in the state.
A Black person has never represented the entire state of Louisiana in the US Senate. This is our moment. The Miracle on the Mississippi is alive and well.
Based on our performance, James Carville has said that we have a "fighting chance" to flip Louisiana blue, and in an article published this morning he said "[Jamie] has some guts and moxie" but that "his challenge will be raising money."
---
| [](https://kseax8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001DTgYHG1zzpXEiBT-K8J_J3O8SdV8APQMCNWL3w5SH-Drs80CmIKVG81zpIEJKhjwqG4RaVSAYdpGGARnBV3FX3zLa1JhMMI91y7lw0AP6r8muRvx0N6pxzKx6rvOvEIVnnSnZr0oUo6HE8klLGLP1lK4JrCtkbDmdc5nkJ9U9HO65YVxHpD-hwjgcAuUPihMOCmb2_8NCOv_DHOCmUXWnReSUyVFqo42StIU7Gh7zwk=&c=8_47S7L5Ff_AbQ8IXsDhM8jWXgp2tulJkjsQEmneMMB_gVWS2v4n3g==&ch=PyDIGEOoMTsYXlAqz26QYxm3GqFkWEtaBJBSGhCCXMWw8LJW8ZSIhA==)

The backend of our ActBlue shows something that is going to shock Carville, Louisiana, and the nation, when we release the numbers for our Q2 filing with the Federal Election Commission on July 1.
We'll leave the shocking total raise for our Wednesday press release but here's a sneak peak of what we'll soon be reporting -- so far we've received 95,318 contributions from over 57,472 individual donors with an average contribution of $18.82.
This is what our Actblue looked like after we won the primary on Saturday night:

The voters we need to win this are here: Louisiana is one-third Democrat, one-third Republican, one-third no party -- with 75% of independents expressing opposition to the administration.
Reaching them is how we win this and to do that we need money.
We will need a lot more of it to pull off the Miracle on the Mississippi, and we have less than a day and a half until we hit our June 30th end of quarter fundraising deadline after which our numbers will go live for the entire nation to see.
Help us shock the nation and prove that a Democrat can win Louisiana. I am once again asking for your financial support.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134221779/630539847/1895761198?refcode=260629-1-act&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3OTFkYWFkMi1iYjczLWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=viVkl4eIrWzJIccJ9_gYLSOCiKWwF0t2E-91lVP0_FE=&emci=202f57e6-e16f-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&emdi=791daad2-bb73-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&ceid=13185894) Sisters and Brothers – The political future of our country rests upon one very simple principle: the need for working people to stand together and fight back against corporate greed, and create an economy that works for all of us, and not just billionaires and large corporations. So when we have progressive candidates with the guts to take on corporate power in this country, we have to do what we can to support them if we are going to have any chance at transforming this country and creating a government that works for all of us. One of those people is Congressman Chris Deluzio in Pennsylvania. Chris understands that our current healthcare system is broken and wildly expensive. He believes, as I do, that healthcare is a human right, not a privilege, and that we must end the embarrassment of being the only major country on earth that does not guarantee health care to every man, woman and child. That is why he supports Medicare for All. Chris understands that we have a corrupt campaign finance system which allows the very rich and their super PACs to buy and sell politicians. That is why he fights vigorously to end the disastrous Citizens United Supreme Court decision — which allows Big Money to control our political process. Chris understands that too many workers in America are earning starvation wages. That is why he fights to raise the minimum wage to a living wage, to make it easier for workers to join unions, to build the millions of units of low income and affordable housing this country desperately needs and make sure that seniors can retire with dignity and security. Sisters and brothers, Chris's campaign is about more than just one single House seat. His work is about taking on the powerful special interests that dominate our economic and political life. And keeping him in Congress requires all of us to do our part to make it happen. And that is why I am once again asking for your financial support. **[Please contribute $27 or whatever you can afford to Chris Deluzio's campaign for Congress in Pennsylvania. I intend to do my part, but it will take all of us. Not just me. Us.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134221780/630539848/1165067295?refcode=em-260629-act&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3OTFkYWFkMi1iYjczLWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=viVkl4eIrWzJIccJ9_gYLSOCiKWwF0t2E-91lVP0_FE=)** When we act collectively we have the ability not only to create a dynamic progressive movement, but we will be able to transform our nation and create a government that represents all of us, not just the people on top. That’s the goal. Let’s do it. In solidarity, Bernie Sanders [CONTRIBUTE NOW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134221781/630539849/1165067295?refcode=em-260629-act&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3OTFkYWFkMi1iYjczLWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=viVkl4eIrWzJIccJ9_gYLSOCiKWwF0t2E-91lVP0_FE=)

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | Jacob Davis's Market Brief (ads) | | • | Brownstone Research ---|--- | • | StocksToTrade ---|--- | • | Safe Money Report ---|--- | | | Market Commentary Disclaimer We encourage all readers to consult a qualified financial professional — such as a registered investment adviser or licensed broker — before making any investment decision. Peter,
The Supreme Court issued one slightly reasonable ruling today and allowed mail-in ballots that are postmarked by Election Day to be counted after polls close, reaffirming the core power of states to administer elections.
In response, the President of the United States took to Truth Social, to say the very idea of free and fair elections are "more dangerous than World War I, World War II, Pearl Harbor, or September 11th"

Now let me tell you why this mission means so much to me. My name is Eduardo Verastegui. Several years ago, I learned firsthand about the horrific reality of child trafficking. What I heard broke my heart. Children were being bought and sold.
Families were being torn apart.
Lives were being destroyed. **I couldn't forget it.** **I couldn't stay silent.** I kept asking myself one question: **"What if it were my child?"** That question changed my life. What started as a film project became a mission and a calling. That calling eventually led me to help produce the film _Sound of Freedom_. **Not for fame.**
**Not for awards.**
**But because I believed people needed to see the truth.** For years, many people said the film would never succeed. Doors closed.
Studios walked away.
People told us to give up. **But when innocent children are suffering, silence is not an option.** And while the film helped awaken millions of people to this crisis, awareness alone is not enough. That is why we created the **Sound of Freedom Foundation**. Our mission is simple: **To stop the sale of God's children.**

clean_body: Get your FREE t-shirt Make your first gift today and receive a FREE "God's Children Are Not For Sale" t-shirt as our thank-you. | | | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | | Peter, I want to start with two simple words. Thank you. Thank you for caring about children you may never meet. Thank you for believing that every child has value and for refusing to accept a world where innocent children can be bought and sold. Because that is exactly what is happening. Every day. God's children are not for sale. And today, I'd like to send you a shirt that boldly declares that truth. When you make your first gift to the Sound of Freedom Foundation today, we'll send you a FREE white "God's Children Are Not For Sale" t-shirt as our thank-you. | | | | | | | | This isn't a shirt you'll find in a store. You can't buy it online. It was created exclusively for supporters of the Sound of Freedom Foundation. People who believe children deserve safety, refuse to look away and are willing to stand up and say: "No more." Every time you wear it, you'll be sharing a message that matters. A message that reminds the world that every child has God-given dignity. And importantly, a message that sparks conversations and helps raise awareness about a crisis many people still do not see. Most of all Peter, I hope this shirt reminds you that you are part of something bigger than yourself. A growing movement of people determined to protect vulnerable children. Please accept this shirt as our way of saying thank you for joining this mission. Give any amount today and choose your shirt size and select a color. Now let me tell you why this mission means so much to me. My name is Eduardo Verastegui. Several years ago, I learned firsthand about the horrific reality of child trafficking. What I heard broke my heart. Children were being bought and sold. Families were being torn apart. Lives were being destroyed. I couldn't forget it. I couldn't stay silent. I kept asking myself one question: "What if it were my child?" That question changed my life. What started as a film project became a mission and a calling. That calling eventually led me to help produce the film Sound of Freedom. Not for fame. Not for awards. But because I believed people needed to see the truth. For years, many people said the film would never succeed. Doors closed. Studios walked away. People told us to give up. But when innocent children are suffering, silence is not an option. And while the film helped awaken millions of people to this crisis, awareness alone is not enough. That is why we created the Sound of Freedom Foundation. Our mission is simple: To stop the sale of God's children. Every day, vulnerable children are targeted by traffickers who prey on poverty, instability, loneliness, and fear. And every day, we work to fight back. Jesus said, "Let the little children come to me, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these." (Matthew 19:14) Every child is precious in God's eyes. Every child is created with dignity, purpose, and worth. And every child deserves someone willing to stand up and fight for them When you make your first gift today, you help: Prevent exploitation by helping strengthen vulnerable families before traffickers can prey on children. Support intervention efforts by equipping trusted partners working to help rescue children trapped in exploitation. Educate parents and communities about the warning signs traffickers use to target children. Raise awareness so more people understand the reality of this crisis. Advocate for stronger protections for vulnerable children and greater accountability for traffickers. This is how change happens. One person refuses to ignore the suffering, refuses to stay silent, and chooses to fight for a child they may never meet. Today, that person can be you. Will you make your first gift now? Choose your shirt size and select a color. And know that your generosity will help protect vulnerable children and bring hope to those who need it most. Thank you for caring and for standing with vulnerable children. Thank you for choosing action over silence. With gratitude and prayer, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation P.S. Your FREE "God's Children Are Not For Sale**" t-shirt is available only for a limited time and only while supplies last. Please make your first gift today, choose your size, and join a growing movement committed to protecting vulnerable children. Every child matters. Every child deserves freedom. 6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074

# PRESS RELEASE

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
June 29, 2026

**CONTACT**
Todd Cheewing
Todd@Ascent-Strategic.com
**WILLIAMS SLAMS GOODLANDER FOR DODGING VOTES ON LAW ENFORCEMENT, HOMELAND SECURITY, AND TAXPAYER PROTECTION**
WEARE, N.H. — Republican congressional candidate Lily Tang Williams is calling out Congresswoman Maggie Goodlander today for repeatedly voting “Present” instead of taking a clear stand on four key House resolutions.
Goodlander voted “Present” on: • H. Res. 1335 — Condemning government fraud and protecting taxpayer dollars • H. Con. Res. 96 — Expressing support for America’s law enforcement officers • H. Res. 1128 — Backing the Department of Homeland Security • H. Res. 719 — Honoring the life and legacy of Charlie Kirk
“Granite Staters expect their representative to pick a side, not hide behind ‘Present,’” said Lily Tang Williams. “If Maggie Goodlander supports these measures, she should vote yes. If she doesn’t, she should vote no and explain why.” Williams specifically criticized Goodlander’s “Present” vote on supporting law enforcement during National Police Week. “During a week meant to honor the men and women who risk their lives to keep us safe, Goodlander couldn’t bring herself to vote yes,” Williams said. “That sends the wrong message to police officers and their families across New Hampshire.” “Leadership means making decisions and standing behind them,” Williams added. “New Hampshire deserves representatives who are willing to be counted — not ones who duck the tough votes.”
**About Lily Tang Williams**
Born in China just before Mao’s Cultural Revolution to working-class parents, Lily Tang Williams immigrated to the United States with nothing and built a life as an entrepreneur, educator, and community leader in Weare, NH. A living embodiment of the American Dream, she brings a uniquely powerful perspective to the fight for freedom and limited government.

In 2024, Williams won the Republican nomination and captured 47% of the general election vote against current incumbent Maggie Goodlander — coming closer than any Republican has in more than a decade to flipping NH-02. She is back and running stronger than ever in 2026.

name: Troy Downing
subject: I traded a comfortable life to fly rescue missions in Afghanistan
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Troy Downing for Congress
body:
Can you give me just a couple of minutes of your time?

| Peter,
How many members of Congress do you know who can fly nearly every type of aircraft, have developed a successful tech startup and enlisted in the Air Force at 34 years old?
My name is Troy Downing – can you give me just a couple of minutes of your time to share my story? I promise you, it's not going to be one you'll forget.
In my youth, I helped develop graphics technology at an NYU lab that won an Academy Award and built a successful startup that merged with Yahoo!
And in 2001, I had a beautiful life. I went from a dirt-poor childhood to having a beautiful wife, a home, and four kids of my own.
---
[](https://trk.emails.troydowning.-7oIog)
---
Then came September 11th.
Like millions of Americans, I watched the horror of that day unfold. But as a 34-year-old businessman, I couldn't just sit back and watch others fight for our freedom.
I knew I had to give back to the country that gave me everything.
I walked right into a military recruitment office, looked the recruiter in the eye, and said, "Hey, I have a commercial pilot's license, I used to teach math at NYU – what can you do with me?"
I signed on the dotted line, went to boot camp, and proudly joined a U.S. Air Force Combat Search and Rescue squadron.
---
[](https://trk.emails.troydowning.)
---
I served eight years and did two tours of duty in Afghanistan on grueling rescue missions to save wounded soldiers on the battlefield. Our squadron lived by a sacred motto:
“These things we do, that others may live.”
And after two tours in Afghanistan, the good people of Montana elected me to the U.S. House of Representatives – I’ve even been endorsed by President Trump TWICE!
---
[](https://trk.emails.troydowning._Yh1IlZgZwH93guSA)
---
But right now, the battlefield has changed – and the stakes have never been higher. I am running for re-election to Congress, and every single seat in these Midterms matters if we want to protect and defend our GOP House Majority.
Peter, I’m not someone who loves asking for money. In fact, it’s one of the hardest parts of this job. But the reality of modern campaigns is that I cannot fight this battle alone. I don’t need a small fortune from a few wealthy insiders – I need a strong team of everyday patriots standing in the trenches with me.
If you believe that Washington needs more leaders who put country over self, and if you want to make sure our House of Representatives stays firmly in conservative hands, I would be deeply grateful for your support.
[If you are able, would you consider making a humble, secure contribution of $25, $50, or $100 today? Every dollar, every CENT goes directly toward defending this seat and keeping our GOP House Majority alive.](https://trk.emails.troydowning._HeiQ)
---
| [CHIP IN $25](https://trk.emails.troydowning.)
---
| [CHIP IN $50](https://trk.emails.troydowning.-xuI3ENiGfsQ)
---
| [CHIP IN ANY AMOUNT](https://trk.emails.troydowning._0ajRtYI5gRfLeGIQ)
---
Thank you for your time, your support, and your shared love for this country.
God Bless you,
Troy Downing
U.S. Representative, Montana's 2nd District
---

It's just the truth.Friday, June 26, 2026U.S. Mobilizes for Venezuela5-minute read · 4 storiesLead Story · Disaster ResponseAMERICA GOES BIG ON VENEZUELA QUAKE RELIEF AS DEATH TOLL CLIMBSWhat's HappeningTwo back-to-back earthquakes — a **7.2 followed seconds later by a 7.5** — flattened buildings across northern Venezuela on Wednesday, the country's strongest quakes in more than a century. The confirmed death toll has **climbed past 900 and is still rising** , with hundreds trapped and federal modeling warning the final count could reach the thousands.The SituationThe Trump administration moved fast. Secretary of State Marco Rubio promised a large, rapid, whole-of-government response, and the U.S. deployed its elite Fairfax County and Los Angeles County search-and-rescue teams, committed roughly **$150 million** to faith-based groups and UN relief agencies, and dispatched Marines to help reopen the port of La Guaira as an aid gateway.
* It is one of Washington's strongest disaster responses since USAID was dismantled, with the State Department and military coordinating the effort
* The aid comes months after U.S. forces seized longtime strongman Nicolás Maduro in January
* Mexico, El Salvador, Bolivia and other neighbors also sent rescue crews; foreign nationals are among the dead
* Crews are battling aftershocks and a shortage of heavy machinery as the survival window narrows

The PerspectiveCritics spent a year insisting that winding down USAID meant America could no longer respond to a disaster. This week answered that: elite rescue teams, Marines, and serious money on the ground within days — routed through the State Department and partners instead of a bloated agency. Help is reaching Venezuelans. The bureaucracy that used to take the credit isn't.[Read the full story at NPR](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/74cd0812JVAh3GyCRksPuwshGfRtloUwLFHS%2FvMsixQExCB6ho%2BWjpy4rxKu%0AHcL%2Fs9OP72%2BqOmDHRyc3pJbDnpfzyIGo0%2BOUSEnC9EBWWS6YjF2ekULqxB10%0A9a3us7iYK7Uj7aaXpANGscID3noQpx0bzsNrXOfUClHqAjnWefvRn0n1qK6Q%0A48BnU9ntib2GWUlaJiWl6qxF6f%2B3p3RtfA%3D%3D%0A/ea53ea742f37fca0)Courts & ElectionsOBAMA JUDGE PERMANENTLY BLOCKS TRUMP'S PROOF-OF-CITIZENSHIP ORDERWhat's HappeningU.S. District Judge **Denise Casper** in Boston, an Obama appointee, permanently barred the administration from enforcing most of Trump's first elections executive order — including its requirement that voters show documentary proof of citizenship to register and its bar on counting late-arriving mail ballots.The SituationIn a 59-page ruling, Casper held that the Constitution leaves election rules to the states and Congress, not the president, and said the order ran afoul of the separation of powers. It's the latest in a string of court losses for the EO approach.
* Democratic state attorneys general brought the suit; New York's Letitia James cheered the result
* This is exactly why the White House is pressing the **SAVE America Act** through Congress — the durable, legislative route to a citizenship check
* SAVE has passed the House but stalled in the Senate, where Trump wants the filibuster gone
* A separate Supreme Court ruling on whether mail ballots must arrive by Election Day is still pending

The PerspectiveReasonable people can argue about how common noncitizen voting is. What's harder to argue is that confirming a voter is a citizen is somehow radical. If a single executive can't order it, then Congress should — and that's precisely the fight the administration is now picking on Capitol Hill.[Read the full story at PBS News](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/Ml8u6eSgrFDROvkABatJpMeJ2%2FazJXcHzlKLyB0Z%2FkfjqGu9fliH%2FygpeiHM%0Ar%2Fa7M5XDWdCUNyb7Pn1Dnjh264%2F0dIDkmxePtGjHu%2FJyTTInKx7MMUyCCHIW%0A5pRwkIpwrTZuj%2B4PP9ijsRn0IeL%2BRwsI6PGVweDlWxCAwvSGdbntFpjBJ3Zj%0A0RgE%2BAuAXU5grruEeyh14gHY8N4K6CkyTw%3D%3D%0A/87d633ae2c9fe16f)The EconomyTRUMP SICS THE DOJ ON BIG OIL AS PUMP PRICES LAG FALLING CRUDEWhat's HappeningIn a post-midnight message, the president said he has ordered the Justice Department to investigate oil companies he accuses of **“gouging”** drivers — charging too much at the pump while the crude they buy keeps falling.The SituationGas has actually been dropping as the Iran ceasefire holds — the national average is around **$3.92 a gallon, down nearly 13%** in a month and back under $4 for the first time since the war began. Trump's complaint: not fast enough.
* A DOJ spokesperson said fuel prices are a national-security issue that hits every American's wallet
* The industry's main trade group says pump prices simply don't move in lockstep with crude, especially after a war-driven supply shock
* Analysts note refiners work through pricier inventory for weeks, so relief at the pump tends to lag the market

The PerspectivePresidents of both parties have run this play when pump prices sting, and past probes rarely find much. But the politics are simple and defensible: crude is down, families are still paying war-time prices, and the president would rather lean on the refiners than on the drivers. Whether DOJ finds anything is almost beside the point.[Read the full story at NBC News](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/F56FoXn6Tj7yHUqNYWtAKDIAiMDCpvrKjjgpiGqODUjqLg6WgoQZRJcKmekS%0AoOSyief6awZC8UQuJ2JDX7U1pdrWJKvYB0JovPX05EGfQzdbTVXvzIvOEfCF%0AYFGoDjPwKp2owAxoZZ5503KRiMwA4%2B44dVBZcgYHnt56i9d%2Fmev3o3167zDR%0AHVyromWgis4%2BMNusVjslqcCcu3Ed597htQ%3D%3D%0A/b5bc13e3b214614f)The 2026 MapSOCIALISTS SWEEP NEW YORK — AND HAND THE GOP A MIDTERM GIFTWhat's HappeningA slate of candidates backed by New York Mayor **Zohran Mamdani** swept Tuesday's Democratic House primaries, knocking off two sitting members of Congress and signaling the democratic socialist wing's growing grip on the party in deep-blue districts.The SituationFormer Comptroller Brad Lander ousted Rep. Dan Goldman, and 32-year-old organizer Darializa Avila Chevalier toppled five-term Rep. Adriano Espaillat, who chairs the Congressional Hispanic Caucus. A third Mamdani pick, Claire Valdez, also won.
* All three campaigned on “abolish ICE,” “tax the rich,” and calling Israel's war in Gaza a “genocide”
* House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries campaigned against the slate — and lost, then downplayed the results
* The NRCC quickly declared the Democratic Party now **“belongs to the socialists”**
* The leftward lurch wasn't universal — a moderate crushed progressives in a safe Utah seat the same night

The PerspectiveIn safe New York seats this is mostly an intra-Democrat story. But Republicans couldn't script a better midterm contrast: “abolish ICE” and “tax the rich” are the exact slogans the GOP wants on the ballot in swing districts — and Jeffries just got rolled in his own backyard.[Read the full story at PBS News](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/sEMVGZTGT81Hafj2Icu8RzuhAXmg9dwRvCGzRE4CJVzKhyJHZTrDFLue6HM2%0AUg45X5x2NwXeufP%2Fzo1GsOLqGZvTIk%2BIQ9J3ewCOABEgWt4%2BP%2BgIKcfVnASy%0AaLCDc50veMEG8vyrDdkzeJGEtwvK5VX6VNu7gAXHPMgkBG7lZfcbp43GZoA4%0AGCzIeUh8W%2FtW4sd7SXdfujgQuUcymlrFHw%3D%3D%0A/034a5fd52d8f7a51)⚡ The Bottom LineAmerica mounted a fast, muscular relief mission in Venezuela without the old aid bureaucracy, a court blocked the citizenship-check order and pushed the fight back to Congress, the president put Big Oil on notice as pump prices fall, and New York Democrats handed the keys to the socialist wing. **Strength abroad, a battle over election integrity at home, and a Democratic Party drifting left. That's just the truth.** "The truth isn't conservative or liberal. It's just the truth."This newsletter presents news from a conservative perspective. We encourage seeking multiple sources. The confirmed death toll has climbed past 900 and is still rising , with hundreds trapped and federal modeling warning the final count could reach the thousands.The SituationThe Trump administration moved fast. Secretary of State Marco Rubio promised a large, rapid, whole-of-government response, and the U.S. deployed its elite Fairfax County and Los Angeles County search-and-rescue teams, committed roughly $150 million to faith-based groups and UN relief agencies, and dispatched Marines to help reopen the port of La Guaira as an aid gateway. It is one of Washington's strongest disaster responses since USAID was dismantled, with the State Department and military coordinating the effort The aid comes months after U.S. forces seized longtime strongman Nicolás Maduro in January Mexico, El Salvador, Bolivia and other neighbors also sent rescue crews; foreign nationals are among the dead Crews are battling aftershocks and a shortage of heavy machinery as the survival window narrows The PerspectiveCritics spent a year insisting that winding down USAID meant America could no longer respond to a disaster. This week answered that: elite rescue teams, Marines, and serious money on the ground within days — routed through the State Department and partners instead of a bloated agency. Help is reaching Venezuelans. The bureaucracy that used to take the credit isn't. & ElectionsOBAMA JUDGE PERMANENTLY BLOCKS TRUMP'S PROOF-OF-CITIZENSHIP ORDERWhat's HappeningU.S. District Judge Denise Casper in Boston, an Obama appointee, permanently barred the administration from enforcing most of Trump's first elections executive order — including its requirement that voters show documentary proof of citizenship to register and its bar on counting late-arriving mail ballots.The SituationIn a 59-page ruling, Casper held that the Constitution leaves election rules to the states and Congress, not the president, and said the order ran afoul of the separation of powers. It's the latest in a string of court losses for the EO approach. Democratic state attorneys general brought the suit; New York's Letitia James cheered the result This is exactly why the White House is pressing the SAVE America Act through Congress — the durable, legislative route to a citizenship check SAVE has passed the House but stalled in the Senate, where Trump wants the filibuster gone A separate Supreme Court ruling on whether mail ballots must arrive by Election Day is still pending The PerspectiveReasonable people can argue about how common noncitizen voting is. What's harder to argue is that confirming a voter is a citizen is somehow radical. If a single executive can't order it, then Congress should — and that's precisely the fight the administration is now picking on Capitol Hill. EconomyTRUMP SICS THE DOJ ON BIG OIL AS PUMP PRICES LAG FALLING CRUDEWhat's HappeningIn a post-midnight message, the president said he has ordered the Justice Department to investigate oil companies he accuses of “gouging” drivers — charging too much at the pump while the crude they buy keeps falling.The SituationGas has actually been dropping as the Iran ceasefire holds — the national average is around $3.92 a gallon, down nearly 13% in a month and back under $4 for the first time since the war began. Trump's complaint: not fast enough. A DOJ spokesperson said fuel prices are a national-security issue that hits every American's wallet The industry's main trade group says pump prices simply don't move in lockstep with crude, especially after a war-driven supply shock Analysts note refiners work through pricier inventory for weeks, so relief at the pump tends to lag the market The PerspectivePresidents of both parties have run this play when pump prices sting, and past probes rarely find much. But the politics are simple and defensible: crude is down, families are still paying war-time prices, and the president would rather lean on the refiners than on the drivers. Dan Goldman, and 32-year-old organizer Darializa Avila Chevalier toppled five-term Rep. Adriano Espaillat, who chairs the Congressional Hispanic Caucus. A third Mamdani pick, Claire Valdez, also won. All three campaigned on “abolish ICE,” “tax the rich,” and calling Israel's war in Gaza a “genocide” House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries campaigned against the slate — and lost, then downplayed the results The NRCC quickly declared the Democratic Party now “belongs to the socialists” The leftward lurch wasn't universal — a moderate crushed progressives in a safe Utah seat the same night The PerspectiveIn safe New York seats this is mostly an intra-Democrat story. It’s time to stand up and use our collective voice to make a change.
#

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q22026.A9rDp6&refcode=em260629-1-b&t=1&akid=11593%2E3935704%2EGVGJBM)
---
Hi there, Jimmy Kimmel here.
I know you’re used to seeing me on your TV screen, but today I’m reaching out to you about an important topic close to my heart: _ending America’s gun violence crisis._
Gun violence isn’t always in the headlines, and it can be far too easy for us to go about our daily lives and forget that it’s happening each and every day. But for the families who now have empty seats at their dinner table — like the families who lost a child in Newtown, Parkland, or Uvalde — they can never, ever forget.
**GIFFORDS is doing lifesaving work at the forefront of the gun safety movement, and I'm proud to be an ambassador for this incredible organization.[Will you join me in supporting GIFFORDS PAC by making a contribution to support their work before their critical end-of-quarter deadline tomorrow?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q22026.A9rDp6&refcode=em260629-1-b&t=2&akid=11593%2E3935704%2EGVGJBM)
**[DONATE](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q22026.A9rDp6&refcode=em260629-1-b&t=3&akid=11593%2E3935704%2EGVGJBM)**
Gun violence is a uniquely American epidemic. The leading cause of death for children in our nation is gun violence.
This is the only developed country in the world where this happens. We have to do something to change this.
Laws such as universal background checks, safe storage laws, and extreme risk protection orders would help ensure that guns can’t fall into the hands of people who shouldn’t have access to them. We call these laws common sense because that’s just what they are — common sense.
It is long past time for our representatives to do their job and truly represent the American people. The majority of Americans support commonsense gun safety legislation.
_But instead, the Trump administration is focused on making guns even easier to buy and lining the pockets of his gun lobby allies._
This is not a moment where we can sit back. We must be loud and use our collective voice to make a change. So please:

Your support before their big end-of-quarter deadline is crucial:**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q22026.A9rDp6&refcode=em260629-1-b&t=4&akid=11593%2E3935704%2EGVGJBM)

Peter, Keith Self is so afraid that his extremist pal Ken Paxton might lose to James Talarico, he is now floating the idea of taking away your right to elect your own U.S. senators. Before 1913, senators were picked by state legislators instead of voters, and the system was so corrupt that wealthy interests openly bribed lawmakers to buy seats. Americans got fed up and passed the 17th Amendment to put that power back where it belongs, with the people. **Just last week, Keith Self introduced a joint resolution to repeal the 17th Amendment.** He wants to drag us all the way back to the days when a handful of wealthy white donors and political insiders decided who represented Texas. He wants this because deep down he knows his hate-filled, fear-mongering politics is wearing thin with voters, **and he is panicking that we are up two points on him in the latest poll.**

Before 1913, senators were picked by state legislators instead of voters, and the system was so corrupt that wealthy interests openly bribed lawmakers to buy seats. Americans got fed up and passed the 17th Amendment to put that power back where it belongs, with the people. Just last week, Keith Self introduced a joint resolution to repeal the 17th Amendment. He wants to drag us all the way back to the days when a handful of wealthy white donors and political insiders decided who represented Texas. He wants this because deep down he knows his hate-filled, fear-mongering politics is wearing thin with voters, and he is panicking that we are up two points on him in the latest poll. Self is doing exactly what frightened little men have always done when they feel power slipping. Instead of trying to win your vote, he would rather make sure you never get to cast it. We are in the final 48 hours of our end of quarter FEC deadline and we are just about $6,000 away from our online fundraising goal. #
Peter,
Last week, a federal judge rejected the Trump DOJ’s politically motivated investigation into Tim Walz and other Minnesota leaders.
The message was clear: Donald Trump _does not_ get to use the Department of Justice to intimidate his political opponents.
Trump and his allies want anyone who challenges them to think twice. They want Democratic leaders looking over their shoulders. They want public servants, organizers, and everyday people to wonder if standing up to them will come at a price.
**We cannot let that become normal.**
Small Town PAC is working to support Democrats who refuse to be intimidated — leaders who show up everywhere, take on the politics of fear and division, and fight for communities that deserve better than Trump’s bullying and chaos.
But our June 30 end-of-quarter deadline is tomorrow, and we still have a ways to go before we hit our $50,000 goal.
After this deadline, our fundraising report will become public. Trump’s allies will be looking for weakness, and we need to show them that this team is not backing down.

# **Supreme Court upholds Mississippi law allowing late-arriving mail ballots**
The Supreme Court **[ruled 5-4 Monday to uphold a Mississippi law permitting mail ballots](https://substack.com/redirect/8453995b-2fe8-400e-8551-12eae7186cab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** postmarked by Election Day to be counted if received up to five days afterward. Justice Amy Coney Barrett wrote the majority opinion, joined by Chief Justice Roberts and the court's three liberal justices, concluding that federal election statutes do not override state laws governing ballot receipt deadlines.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8453995b-2fe8-400e-8551-12eae7186cab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The ruling was notable for its unusual coalition,** with Barrett and Roberts crossing ideological lines to side with the court's liberal bloc. During oral arguments in March, several justices had expressed concern that allowing late-arriving ballots could undermine the concept of a single Election Day.
* **The decision carries significant implications for November elections,** affecting 14 states that currently allow mail ballots to arrive days or even weeks after Election Day. The case was one of four election-related disputes the court heard this term.

York City, which follows strong primary victories in Ohio, Pennsylvania,
California, Montana, New Jersey and Arizona.

status quo politics and a corrupt campaign finance system which benefits
only the rich and powerful. They want a government that represents all of
us and not just a handful of billionaires. And they are supporting
candidates who will do just that.

Kiros' campaign for Congress in Colorado. Melat is running a strong
grassroots campaign against an establishment incumbent. In the last week
alone she has faced more than $700,000 in outside spending. In other
words, the establishment is doing everything possible to defeat her. But,
if she has our financial support in these final days, she can win.

Melat was born in Ethiopia, moved to America as a child and was raised in
a working-class immigrant household. She understands that healthcare is a
human right, that housing must be affordable and that the billionaires and
large corporations should not be allowed to buy our elections.

And she has the courage to stand up for what is right: Melat was fired
from her law firm for speaking out in defense of students protesting the
genocide in Gaza, and she believes we should not be spending huge amounts
of money to fund unconstitutional and illegal wars. As a member of
Congress, she will vote to end all military support to the extremist
government in Israel.

this link to split a contribution between her campaign and the Justice

Let me say a few words as to why this race and your support is so
important.

Poll after poll shows that Americans understand that the U.S. is moving in
the wrong direction. Today, we have unprecedented income and wealth
inequality with the rich getting much richer while working families
struggle to survive. We have a corrupt campaign finance system which
allows billionaires to buy elections and undermine our democracy. Our
health care system is broken and wildly expensive. We have a major housing
crisis with 800,000 homeless and millions of families spending half their
incomes or more on housing. People are deeply worried about the impact
that AI and robotics will have on their lives.

And on and on it goes.

Now more than ever, we need candidates who have the guts to stand up to
the Oligarchy and fight to bring meaningful improvement to people's lives.
Melat is one of those candidates.

Her primary is tomorrow and, as I mentioned above, she is facing an
obscene amount of outside spending -- the kind we have seen in many
primaries across the country over the past few months.

So with time running out, I am once again asking for your financial
support.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/141137?c0=jd-em-20260629-1-mk.3egKod&refcode=em20260629-37970&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=37970%2E1203867%2Eg2KSbm ]If electing leaders with the guts to stand up to the billionaire class
and large corporations trying to buy our elections is important to you,
please split a contribution of $27 or whatever you can afford directly to

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/141137?c0=jd-em-20260629-1-mk.3egKod&refcode=em20260629-37970&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=37970%2E1203867%2Eg2KSbm ]Contribute $27

Sisters and brothers - our agenda is not the agenda of the Democratic
establishment of this country. And if we want a government that represents

In solidarity,

Bernie Sanders

I have a lot of thoughts about what’s been going on with Pete Hegseth.
Not only did he remove me from my position as Chief of the Navy Reserve after 35 years of service, but he’s actively undermining the foundation of our military.
Hegseth has fired more than a dozen senior military officers, including an Army chief of staff and two other generals who were ousted recently.
And now, he’s waging a war with Iran that could put our national security and countless American lives on the line.
That kind of behavior isn’t just destabilizing – it’s dangerous.
Now more than ever, we need leadership that’s rooted in honor, service, and respect. And that’s exactly why I’m running for Congress in South Carolina’s First District.
If we’re going to flip this seat and take back a Democratic House Majority, I need your help. Can you make a split donation of $25 or whatever you can, to Resist Reclaim Rebuild and my campaign? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-lacore]

| | | | | | Hi Peter,
Tonight at 6pm we will be hosting a panel with some of my closest friends to talk about the impact young people are having on healthcare, technology, and politics.

---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/oEKd3LfOnP2?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
| |
I loved being a counselor at Camp Kesem, and spending time with my amazing fellow counselors and the kids who attended. Camp Kesem is for children whose parents have been diagnosed with cancer and are going through really serious life events, and my fellow counselors were incredible leaders helping these kids through difficult times. Now years later, they are still doing meaningful work and helping make the world better in so many different ways.
At our panel tonight, we will talk about how young people are changing the world, and the work my friends are doing to help make a difference. We will connect, share some stories from camp, and open for questions at the end. Please join me for this virtual fundraiser tonight from 6 pm -7pm!
[**If you would like to join us, please sign up here, and consider making a donation to help me (a young person!) continue to be part of a new generation of leaders making change in Wisconsin.**](https://us.list-manage.com/NiI0iYnab0Q?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)

Best,Dylan

Good morning. The last week has been a whirlwind. I am profoundly grateful for the faith and trust that the people of NY-17 have put in me, and I do not take my responsibility to beat Mike Lawler lightly. But I wanted to pause for a moment and tell you about why I’m running for Congress in the first place. I was a junior in high school on 9/11 when the Twin Towers fell. The next day, I began my West Point application. I graduated in the top of my class, and did six overseas deployments serving in Iraq and Afghanistan. I did that out of a love for this country. Back then, I never thought that the greatest threat to our nation would come from within our own borders. But the people running this administration do not share our values – or the values of the generations of Americans who fought and sacrificed to make this country better. **So I made the decision to run for Congress, again, out of love for this country.** My opponent, Mike Lawler, has rubber stamped this administration’s worst decisions. He has chosen corruption over service, and voted 100% of the time with a MAGA agenda that has gutted our healthcare, jacked up costs, and undermined our democracy and freedoms. Our campaign has a clear path to beating him and flipping this seat. But we’re in for a fight. He’s got nearly limitless sums of MAGA dark money. I’ve got this grassroots team. [**If you care about taking back the House, I’m asking you to contribute $10 to my campaign in NY-17. clean_body: | | | | Good morning. The last week has been a whirlwind. I am profoundly grateful for the faith and trust that the people of NY-17 have put in me, and I do not take my responsibility to beat Mike Lawler lightly. But I wanted to pause for a moment and tell you about why I’m running for Congress in the first place. I was a junior in high school on 9/11 when the Twin Towers fell. The next day, I began my West Point application. I graduated in the top of my class, and did six overseas deployments serving in Iraq and Afghanistan. I did that out of a love for this country. Back then, I never thought that the greatest threat to our nation would come from within our own borders. But the people running this administration do not share our values – or the values of the generations of Americans who fought and sacrificed to make this country better. So I made the decision to run for Congress, again, out of love for this country. My opponent, Mike Lawler, has rubber stamped this administration’s worst decisions. He has chosen corruption over service, and voted 100% of the time with a MAGA agenda that has gutted our healthcare, jacked up costs, and undermined our democracy and freedoms. Our campaign has a clear path to beating him and flipping this seat. But we’re in for a fight. He’s got nearly limitless sums of MAGA dark money.
