body:
Tomorrow at midnight, our fundraising numbers become part of the public record.

| | | | | |
---
| | | | [|
---](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=467f54e9a5&e=c6e7dff14c)
| | Hello Peter,
We have just **ONE DAY LEFT** before our critical FEC fundraising deadline.
Tomorrow at midnight, our fundraising numbers become part of the public record. Political insiders, the media, national organizations, and our opponent will all be looking to see whether our campaign has the resources to compete.This report will send one of two messages:
**Either** our campaign is building the momentum needed to win Ohio's 8th Congressional District...
**Or** that grassroots supporters aren't ready to take on the status quo.I know which message I want to send.
Washington continues to waste taxpayer dollars while too many families here in Ohio are struggling with rising grocery prices, higher utility bills, unaffordable housing, and healthcare costs. Congress keeps talking while everyday people keep paying the price.
I'm running because our district deserves leadership that will put working families first—not wealthy special interests and corporate lobbyists.
Unlike many campaigns, we're not relying on corporate PAC money. We're relying on people like you.
That's why I'm asking you today:
If you can contribute **$10, $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can afford** , please make your contribution before tomorrow's midnight deadline.Every single donation helps us:
* Reach more voters across Ohio's 8th District
* Recruit and train volunteers

I want to tell you something that’s not easy to talk about...
A sitting Republican elected official recently tagged the Department of Homeland Security on social media and wrote:
"I would like to report a foreign occupier. Name: Unpronounceable. Country of origin: Tatooine." He was talking about me. The same official called for the mass deportation of Indian Americans.
I was born in New Delhi. I came to this country as a baby. I grew up in Peoria, Illinois. I went to public schools, got on food stamps for a time with my family, worked my way to Princeton and Harvard Law. I served in government. I got elected to Congress five times.
And someone still looked at all of that and saw a foreign occupier.
I'm telling you this not for sympathy. I'm telling you this because what happened to me is happening to communities all across this country right now, at a scale we have never seen before.
Trump and his MAGA allies have made it clear: if you weren't born here, if your name is hard to pronounce, if you look different or pray differently, you are not fully American in their eyes. They are using the machinery of the federal government to make that point, loudly and cruelly, every single day.
My father came here with nothing. He believed this country would be there for families like ours. It was. Because people fought for it.
That is exactly why I started Equal Opportunity Now.
We need leaders in office who will stand up for immigrant families and for every community that Trump has decided to make an enemy.
Those leaders exist. They are running for office right now. They need our support.
Will you chip in $25 or $50 today to help Equal Opportunity Now back the leaders who won't back down? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-eon]

It’s on us to stop the rising tide of MAGA Extremism. And with your help?
We’ll be unstoppable.
— Raja Krishnamoorthi

name: Brian Lenney
subject: Here's how they do it
body:
RE: visa scams

| |
---|---|---
|
# Here's how they do it
### RE: visa scams
| | | [Brian Lenney](https://substack.com/@brianlenney)
---
| Jun 29
---
| [](https://substack.com/@brianlenney)
---
Take a look at this...

This guy shows you EXACTLY how the foreign worker visa scams work in America.
If you want to see what's really going on, check this out:

[I Exposed Texas' Indian Invasion](https://substack.com/redirect/50871706-ee45-4445-ae93-719f3787bff1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) »

Happy Monday,

Brian
**P.S.**
Micron's a trillion-dollar company that just got $6.1 billion in federal CHIPS Act money (and Governor Brad Little's team personally flew to Chicago to pitch them on expanding in Boise). Then, before I got into office, he signed the Semiconductors for America Act giving them sales tax exemptions on construction. For example, Micron's facility is worth close to $2 billion and they paid $3.4 million in property taxes in 2024. You paid more on your house proportionally. And the county assessor even said that when Micron's bill shrinks, yours grows. That's Idaho taxpayers subsidizing a trillion-dollar corporation.
Funny thing is, Little actually warned about this exact kind of corporate welfare back when he was a state rep when he said something like "tax concessions don't guarantee a thing" (about the Areva deal**).** But then he became governor and started signing them anyway. And now Tommy Ahlquist (the guy Little beat in the 2018 primary for Governor, by the way) is building a [920-acre industrial park off I-84](https://substack.com/redirect/1fc94963-4a42-4499-907c-d3784d90e682?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) positioned to serve Micron's suppliers. 10,000 homes planned and Little will likely be the one who approves the casino that anchors the whole thing.
_**So ask yourself who all that infrastructure is really for.**_
_**Because your kids aren 't getting those jobs. **_
Visa holders and foreign workers are, people from cultures with no connection to Idaho who have zero interest in becoming Idahoans. Your children get to compete for scraps in their own state while a trillion-dollar corporation cashes checks their governor wrote on their future.
**P.P.S.**
In February, [Tommy Ahlquist walked into the Capitol with the Home Builders Association, the Dairymen's Association, and the Farm Bureau](https://substack.com/redirect/f01a68da-db02-4580-982b-f3980d55dade?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to brag about how much they love illegal labor. His actual quote? "Let's give President Trump the space he needs to solve the workforce problem and stay away from government red tape policies like E-Verify." Then they released a whole study about how foreign-born workers prop up Idaho's construction, agriculture, and hospitality industries. Little said nothing. Because the whole thing falls apart if they don't have each other. Little gets to brag about Micron jobs for his legacy while Ahlquist walks away with land deals and Micron pockets billions in subsidies plus a cheap labor pipeline nobody's allowed to question.
The last time Micron got big tax breaks from Idaho they laid off 1,100 people, so maybe think about that.
Your tax dollars fund the construction. Illegal labor builds it. They bring in a foreign workforce to fill the jobs and call it "economic development" while Idaho families foot the bill for a state they're slowly being replaced in.
(C) 2026 Brian Lenney
[Unsubscribe](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9icmlhbmxlbm5leS5zdWJzdGFjay5jb20vYWN0aW9uL2Rpc2FibGVfZW1haWw_.GkG_2Mr9BXxURy_QdMOtw7T6JfTp21sr-LaMLdfCt00?)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/9a780d19-914e-406b-8599-18bf233b43b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)[](https://substack..YB_S2DF0MVgmqbGYe8umB5PaTVaaWgmP0ivt5AbZVFA?)

From Parade Routes to Doorsteps: Medical Lake, Colville, Hoopfest, & GOTV!

| | | | | [|

|

# Medical Lake Founders Day: Celebrating Our Heritage
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/wpKDnRmL_Oj?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)
| | It was great to be back at the Medical Lake Founders Day Parade along with my family and campaign team last weekend. The streets were lined with neighbors waving flags and cheering, and I really enjoyed visiting with the many community groups taking part. The children especially enjoyed handing out candy, and I counted 331 high-fives along the route!
Thank you to the Medical Lake community for the warm welcome, and to all the volunteers who came out to join us. We are so grateful for your wonderful support!
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
|
---
| |
# Colville Rodeo Parade: Riding Proud, Riding Strong
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/fO6ezgNExcP?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)
| | Team Baumgartner was proud to participate in this year's Colville Rodeo Parade, one of Northeast Washington's favorite summer traditions. My team had a great time handing out candy, high-fiving, and visiting with many members of the community. It was especially rewarding to see so many families and local organizations come together to celebrate.
Thank you to the organizers and volunteers who made the parade such a success, and everyone who came out to cheer us on. Special thanks to the Stevens County Republican Party for their great support and enthusiasm.
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
| |
# Summer Parkways: Serving Smiles on Spokane’s South Hill
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/BUdk4cADeOO?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)
| | This year’s Summer Parkways on Spokane’s South Hill was especially fun since it took place on the first day of summer break for many local families! The event once again brought together cyclists, walkers, runners, and families to enjoy the car-free streets. It was great to see so many people connecting with their friends and neighbors while enjoying a beautiful summer day.
Team Baumgartner had fun handing out popsicles and greeting members of the community. Thank you to everyone who stopped by, and to the organizers and volunteers who made Summer Parkways such a success once again!

---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
|
---
| |
# Making Shots & Connections at Spokane’s Hoopfest!
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| | Team Baumgartner had a great time at Hoopfest in Spokane this weekend! Between the energy of the players of all ages, the packed crowds, and the excitement of our world-leading outdoor basketball tournament - it was all a great celebration of “Hooptown USA”. We spent the morning serving coffee, meeting families, and having meaningful conversations about issues that matter here in Eastern Washington.
---
|
---
| |
# Knocking on Doors in Spokane
---
|
---
| |
My team and our fantastic volunteers have been out knocking on doors in Spokane to meet folks and talk about the campaign, and we have really appreciated the many great conversations with neighbors! One porch at a time, we’re building real connections and turning that energy into a strong turnout this August and November!
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
|
---
| |
# Volunteer Spotlight: Jane and John
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | A special thank you to our volunteers Jane and John for their outstanding support during this year’s parade season. They have gone above and beyond by generously offering their vehicle for decoration and bringing their positive spirit to the festivities. We are incredibly grateful they made the long drive out to join us and take part in celebrating with the community.
Their willingness to contribute time, resources, and effort is a wonderful example of community spirit in action. We are grateful for their enthusiasm, flexibility, and dedication to making these events a success. Volunteers like Jane and John make a real difference, and we appreciate everything they do!
---
|
---
|
---
| |

---
| | Primary election ballots will be mailed out in less than three weeks! _**Will you host a yard sign? Now is the time! **_Click [**here**](https://us.list-manage.com/dRXqfEUg3ma?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238) to sign up, or just send an email reply!We need volunteers! If you have a couple of hours to spare, please reach out to us! Visit our [**website**](https://us.list-manage.com/NNVaNWfyYP3?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)**** to sign up now!**Upcoming Events** Our campaign is in full swing as Team Baumgartner travels across Eastern Washington connecting with communities and celebrating local traditions. This event features local entries, music, and family activities.
**Saturday July 18th:**_**Davenport Pioneer Days Parade:**_ Join Team Baumgartner at 11 am for Davenport Pioneer Days Parade in Lincoln County. This event features a 5k, chalk contest, fishing derby, parade and so much more![T](https://us.list-manage.com/VaJ7oL3K1Cz?e=5a45b9550e&c2id=b2f1dd870633a757190c0f1edbcab238)hank you for all your encouragement and support!-Michael

body:
How JD Vance found his way back to faith

| | | |
---
| | | Fellow Patriot,
---
Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth.

He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him.

He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country.

That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt.

**That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,_Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith._**

Each week, I send an email to our volunteer list with the current week's events, our most pressing volunteer needs, and shout outs. To sign up for a lawn sign, visit our [**Volunteer Page**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134257753/630634609/-1115029622?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjMvMS8xMjQ5NTciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTYxYjRjY2QtZGM3My1mMTExLWFjOWMtMDAwZDNhNTRiZWQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=CqI40p8eLEsqwJXnbhYFnjtCd3LZBv6lkxuBxMhMk5Q=&emci=225990a8-0170-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&emdi=961b4ccd-dc73-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&ceid=1745378) and check the box to host one (as well as any other boxes that interest you!) They will not automatically be mailed. body:
We want YOU to join our team!

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/jonnyutah4congress/field-report-june-week-5-campaign-newsletter-join-forces-with-jonny?e=c29ddb867a)

| | | | | |
# **Join Forces with Jonny**
---
| | Hi Friend,
Our state of Utah is quite literally ablaze. Record low snow-cap, high temperatures, and dry vegetation have all contributed to an early start in this year’s fire season. Currently, over [100,000 acres](https://jonnyutah4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc76e2ed74de192812d6308cf&id=b1f4994dfd&e=c29ddb867a) are burning across Utah’s 3rd and 4th districts. Thanks to the combined effort of both Utah and out-of-state teams, residents in Eureka, Mammoth, and Silver City affected by the Iron fire were allowed to return to their homes yesterday, and [remain on “Set” status](https://jonnyutah4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc76e2ed74de192812d6308cf&id=daa2a6381a&e=c29ddb867a). Please support those taking on this high-risk work by abstaining from firework use this season, and keeping your drones at home!
---
|
---
| |
## We want YOU to join our team!
---
|
---
| |
We are looking for a few people to join our team! We need help with our social media content creation, and field photography and video! If this feels like you, please reach out to our team at **volunteer@jonnyutah4congress.com**. We’ll be in touch!

We are nearly out of yard signs! We would love your help reaching our end of quarter goal. $30 pays for 3 yard signs, and any amount helps!
---
| [Donate](https://jonnyutah4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc76e2ed74de192812d6308cf&id=b2c13db955&e=c29ddb867a)
---
| |
We love how many of you we’re meeting as volunteers, and we need more of you! We would love your help with the parades this weekend for America’s 250!
---
|
---
| |
## Thank you for your support!
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | | After running his own campaign against Utah’s incumbent, Mike Kennedy, we’re so grateful to have the endorsement of fellow veteran, [Glenn Wright](https://jonnyutah4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc76e2ed74de192812d6308cf&id=54dcc7925f&e=c29ddb867a)!
---
| |
The energy at the Fort Herriman Towne Day’s Parade was amazing! It felt so good celebrating with you coming up on this nation’s 250th birthday, engaging with the community, and even meeting some veterans along the route. Thank you so much for the cheers and support! Who knew being [entry #67](https://jonnyutah4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc76e2ed74de192812d6308cf&id=44e1e1ebf2&e=c29ddb867a) would get so many high-fives?
---
|
---
| | If you’d like to keep up on our campaign journey, please update your subscriber preferences in the link below where you can also tell us if you’d like to be in touch for volunteer opportunities! When people get together and organize, we create big change!

It’s a busy weekend with so many festivities celebrating America’s 250th. Come join us this weekend at the Riverton and Grantsville parades!
Yours in solidarity.
Semper Fi,\- Jonny
---
|
---
| |
## **Meet Jonny on the Campaign Trail**
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | Come see us this week out on the campaign and celebrate America’s 250th with us!
**June 29 @ 6:00PM** \- South Jordan Meet and GreetCome meet us at the South Jordan City Park pavilion!
**July 3 @ 6:30PM** \- [Riverton Towne Days Parade](https://jonnyutah4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc76e2ed74de192812d6308cf&id=0ff4436401&e=c29ddb867a)We’d love to see you at Riverton’s Fourth of July celebration!
**July 4 @ 11:00AM** \- [Grantsville Fourth of July Celebration](https://jonnyutah4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc76e2ed74de192812d6308cf&id=0d254d24cc&e=c29ddb867a)
**July 4 @ 6:00PM** \- [Sandy City Independence Day Parade](https://jonnyutah4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc76e2ed74de192812d6308cf&id=04c530a577&e=c29ddb867a)
**July 11 @ 4;30PM** \- I Scream for Representation FundraiserWe’re having an ice cream fundraiser! Please [RVSP](https://jonnyutah4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc76e2ed74de192812d6308cf&id=b4e6a8a6c7&e=c29ddb867a) by July 10. See you there!

name: Jon Husted
subject: Lifted Up on Eagles' Wings
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Husted for Senate
body:
Have you read the Bible verse Isaiah 40:31?
"But those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not be faint." -- Isaiah 40:31
I've lived these words my entire life.
My name is Jon Husted. From my earliest days in foster care, God's hand has guided me. He led me to loving parents who adopted me and taught me faith, family, and hard work.
[](http://links.conservativeum.com/s/c/OuCzF3_JoKSNfFGj8EGbtjipyOuPC2rYWbB_4EBqbgcEHhc-3v4npbA8-QpQcEgtG_SnPt__BOyJPXN80rCjQEq7vBxUqIqoGsxxLm7fjqr2l-VQvBRedyaCQQcRXf4JvtoH6R5xQVFwjpdaoj0q1u_2mNphmxQG1LRcI--xtG9ADSydivlT0lJy7MGlD1kDuFaj7qds3b8RMbLMwoTVQDwOSnmedygdj6MdpG72vGn_bgUQduAAVEw-9m0jMi3fIFUlGslE9eWgIdWrSZfTFSiBx51CS9U1U7HLsA0Cx3UlEb6Kljq6ExshzWYorYe9qxgPyARLFUkQlpBL47nO73nosRriHeYs4aQsRXi6sYOTQwv_3c9jSosSC-IzkT4UHUUSEt73qpHxTFL9KyGe__fl9qNHeza5Kbl1Aam2XNuv-YUJKGbydx2o2lRLgONrNYJqfBXeGj9UWtiw5Ed_TrBGg9O6VEQPad6oY0LbDNlDcvpXcjmxi1kxALGOcu-sg39gZ8_GSjm9ktEXq9HN9jWUzH7rjSPSdB0kaGja6dVh0rs0QCy301Ic_9geqxeKxfKJPcbLpMCDXqN_en5vT2jiUegLdLQ0SWufgI_hJ75NPXrBrfPwvIknqV1GetrkD548dhCjvy2ts8q1AV85mgg3-r7GIG8uQtJ8iEjZ5BwBVxcHW55hbXQvcmcTHz3o2VjUSJwsCe84cWGhN4GtdgDGmSF7bsUdWghokHJmOfM8d8FNJN7dVh-hJU2NsRDgb4bCBhjvAdNnQIln9d4F0Tb5kLVOuSMtndldsvkHehxDw0YhAxcUx9hPUw/Y0JEt25YQWBMB5MBB9MKOWtKOVSrerhM/22)
He gave me opportunities I could never have imagined--like becoming an All-American at the University of Dayton and winning the DIII National Championship in 1989.

Peter,
James Carville -- the Ragin' Cajun, Louisiana legend himself -- just said something about Jamie Davis, the OFFICIAL Democratic nominee for Senate in Louisiana that every Democrat in America NEEDS to hear.
"Jamie's got a lot of guts and moxie. He's a successful farmer, which is a pretty good profile for a Democratic candidate."
The man who knows Louisiana politics better than almost anyone alive just looked at what Jamie built -- 54,600 individual donors, zero corporate PAC money, a runoff win that shocked the political establishment -- and said, "Yeah, that's a damn good profile."
We'll take it, Mr. Carville.
However, Carville didn't stop there. He said Jamie's challenge will be raising money.
And he's right, even though we've got some record-breaking numbers coming in for this quarter - the issue won't just go away.
Why? Well, because: Jamie just became MAGA's number one target in America!
Julia Letlow, our MAGA opponent, and her dark money machine are preparing to open the gates of hell to stop us and are gearing up to run millions in attack ads against a grassroots campaign built entirely on the contributions of working people giving $5, $10, $25 at a time.
They have billionaires. We have 54,600 donors who believe that a fourth-generation farmer from Waterproof, Louisiana can walk into the United States Senate and make history as the first Black senator ever elected from this state.
That's not a fair fight. But it's the fight we're in.
And here's the thing about Jamie Davis: He's never once in his life had a fair fight.
He built a farm from nothing on land his grandfather worked as a sharecropper to 3000 acres. He won a Democratic Senate primary with zero corporate PAC money or establishment support and swept all 64 parishes doing it. Unfair fights are kind of Jamie's specialty.
But Carville is right that raising money to put up with the MAGA Machine is the big challenge. And that's where you come in.
Tonight at midnight is our end-of-quarter deadline. The first fundraising report we file as the official Democratic nominee will tell the entire political world -- every donor, every PAC, every national Democrat deciding where to invest -- whether this race is real or a long shot.
A strong number tomorrow night doesn't just fund our campaign. It unlocks the doors to national support that can match MAGA dollar for dollar.

Peter,

Speaker Mike Johnson recently said he's _**"convinced we're going to defy history and keep the majority here so we can keep all this going..."**_

But let's look at the facts, shall we?...

**FIRST:** Donald Trump and his Republican allies spent months telling Americans not to worry. They downplayed their plans to rig the economy and target our communities. They hid their agenda in plain sight, then, they insisted that the warnings were overblown and that voters had nothing to fear.

**THEN:** They got into power and didn't hesitate to show us exactly who they are. They fired experienced public servants, bullied out qualified Americans who stood in their way, and made it clear that loyalty mattered more than expertise and common sense.

**NOW:** They're shamelessly moving full speed ahead with their dangerous agenda, and aren't even bothering to pretend they care about the families who are paying the price for it.

Peter, we know that the damage they're causing will take years to undo. The most frustrating part is that they don't seem worried about being held accountable. In fact, they're acting like they've already won.

While Americans are worried about their healthcare, their retirement security, their rights, and their future, Republican leaders are openly talking about continuing down this same path. They think voters will forget, they think people will tune out, and they're counting on good people to throw up their hands and decide there's nothing they can do. And if that happens, they'll get exactly what they want.

_Kim refuses to accept that._

Peter,

clean_body: That’s why we created this limited-edition COMMON SENSE SINCE 1776 shirt to celebrate America’s 250th birthday. | Peter, I’ve spent enough time in Washington to learn one thing: Common sense isn’t common enough. But thank the Good Lord, America has managed to hang onto some of it for 250 years. Now, I don’t know who needs to hear this, but freedom isn’t free. Neither is this shirt. And frankly, I like this shirt better than I like omelets. And if you know me, you know I LOVE my omelets. That’s right. | Because after 250 years, America is still standing. The Constitution is still standing. And despite Washington’s best efforts, common sense is still standing too. Let’s celebrate all three. For America, Senator John Kennedy Folks, not long ago, common sense was illegal in all of Washington, D.C. Now, it's just illegal between liberals' ears. Help me restore common sense! Hi there Peter, it's Michele Tafoya!

If I were to take a guess, there's a 50/50 chance you may recognize me from a stadium's big screen.
If that's not the case, I get it... Let me at least tell you briefly about who I am and what I'm about anyway!

I should clarify first, no, I didn't make my career running for touchdowns or kicking game-winning field goals.

I worked as a sideline reporter in professional football for nearly three decades. Working in the sport for that long was a dream come true, and I wouldn't have wanted it any other way.
[Believe me, I know plenty of people who called me crazy for walking away from a career I loved. But life is short, and I was not willing to sit on the sidelines while everything I care about was on the line.](https://links.trueamericanconservatives.com/s/c/n5tr41FxD2uiRFJ76rS3ubtBIvQORS_PuAbazKqFmqYXRaOVhUiQ7-gMm6J32xAeIHxiOf8HliVUydwFdqYN7ZzdqiSJn0sT3snG1JtgnbL851s3vfYdYBup0-QOtD6zvtYadIOhR-w2c5qIOZLbNOm1d_I2q7piMAzbIks57oF1qSnbq5suyOfO2qHjuzpob1i5-WfNsu9ARVO88_X_FZ-xrz4CzBWtBZqVrGnare997NrgYpFz9XVjT6i4vIbxE81NEkvvQA290-3rQhIxSiMx6c21N2dutP4AaSfl7stRA_jvBcoPJV2hEkPK4kFwSf1RdPtFHKEAXM3WCqNGlqdR4WShKYmZMxG77OtSlSCQUkesJwg3s09WDyisC626x6MCrAmYKlA0lx5pLGK79C-ypd-sMSzFM8GbHhZFm6YgyxC0_NZXIPihukIfwlaTCsb2gWF4HgjRxkAaCDEuBgjVIKnBZPZJ5a13kAV5RkkYVPXBrjuM0yqvvMlIZx7BPMXmDNXilWyMxbC9qZYKBJ8xEjtSlXbJF9QXWh_fAc8S9sAYyvRnE2yGZF62Mx_xV5O4fKVOQ68kg6J3brVYSgZB-hYW5qhHw7HXqPOBDPV1Otc3fnEmOHwzscn56bTbp1iMFNATwWryjkswWmqSYISNBhTwohWcrXVK1I_inBhvwe69OAcXdPUsZC825kG_yp7YtX_zLCnHkjMZO6mDeWMkRiv5fC59M7WVRcvN57bWhDPb9rDbQH7QcKHi8Pllzv3pMyUv-s2u60aT9Z0KfTulZ_c6WGIIzHlpDtP5RPXRSOr53a8OsqcvUt9tK1IBAvFBgsrryE8oc8ZqJed9DSY21vE12r936v6iIfZ5fw/-KUR-7WNU52cKZUANcxZsqhHM4OTRICH/22)
I told myself before I officially launched my race for U.S. Senate that we had to be all in or not do it at all.

I burned the boats, Peter, and there's absolutely no looking back.
I will not be canceled. I will not apologize for values that are wholesome and good. And if my voice gives someone else the courage to use theirs, that is exactly why I did it.

I want my daughter and every young American to know one thing:
You earn your place. You think for yourself. And you never let anyone put you in a box. That's the Minnesota I'm fighting for.
Parents who speak up are called transphobes.Girls who lose opportunities are told to be quiet.And women's groups are nowhere to be found.
This is not complicated.
Girls' sports are for girls, and boys' sports are for boys.

The radical Left has done everything in its power to infiltrate some of the most vulnerable minds in our society. I launched this run because just like you, I'm sick of the indoctrination and want to bring back sanity to our country.

It's going to be FAR from easy. Minnesota hasn't had a Republican Senator in nearly two decades! However, it's ripe for a flip....with the disastrous leadership of Governor Walz and the Democratic Party in the state, people are fed up.

It's going to take a grassroots army of patriots, just like you, to propel this movement of ours to victory and shock the world.

Can I level with you?
When I was growing up in Peoria, my family didn't have much. But we had something that mattered more than money: The belief that if you worked hard enough, this country would meet you halfway. That the doors would open. That the next generation would have it better than the last.
I built my entire life around that belief.
But I look around today and I'm concerned. Not for myself — for the families who are where my family was. The ones working two jobs and still falling behind. The kids graduating into mountains of debt. The parents who are doing everything right and still can't afford to keep a roof over their heads.
The American Dream that saved my family is slipping out of reach for millions of people just like us. And I refuse to accept that as inevitable.
That's exactly why I started Equal Opportunity Now.
Because I genuinely believe that if we don't fight like hell right now — to elect leaders who give a damn, to take on the powerful interests rigging the system against working families, to build something that lasts beyond this moment — we are going to lose something we can never get back. Wanda James, Diana DeGette and Melat Kiros participate in a League of Women Voters candidate forum at Montview Presbyterian Church on May 28, 2026, in Denver, Colorado. (Photo by RJ Sangosti/MediaNews Group/The Denver Post via Getty Images)
Super PACs funded by AIPAC and major big tech donors have poured roughly $2 million behind Rep. Diana DeGette on the eve of her contentious primary in Colorado's first congressional district against democratic socialist challenger Melat Kiros.
The June 30 primary in the Denver area has drawn national attention in the wake of Tuesday's sweeping set of wins by democratic socialists in New York. Kiros has run as a critic of unchecked AI development, telling Drop Site News she supports a moratorium on data center construction. Her opposition to Israel's genocide in Gaza and its ongoing efforts at occupation and ethnic cleansing in Lebanon, meanwhile, has drawn the attention of pro-Israel donors hoping to rescue their longtime ally DeGette.
AIPAC, however, is now a political liability in the increasingly blue Colorado; the money being spent against Kiros has flowed instead through PACs associated with women's rights, of which DeGette has long been a champion.
Drop Site is reader-supported and unpaywalled.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZHJvcHNpdGVuZXdzLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.8yJnmrNIGgh7I0qzsVz4zDXYqjiKCI-FlRlmfyo7kkA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=203714530)
The key super PAC in question is called EDW Action Fund, which is affiliated with the member-led PAC Elect Democratic Women (EDW). EDW has been chaired since its 2018 launch by Democratic Rep. Lois Frankel, who quit[ the Congressional Progressive Caucus](https://substack.com/redirect/3ff6b64c-e369-4618-b439-99035fc53354?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in November 2023 in protest of some of its members voicing criticism of Israel's assault on Gaza. The former mayor of West Palm Beach, Frankel was among just six members of the CPC who had recently voted to censure Rep. Rashida Tlaib for using the phrase, "From the river to the sea." Frankel's EDW has frequently been used by AIPAC to funnel money into congressional races.
Now Frankel's PAC is spending heavily against Kiros, largely relying on its sister organization Pro-Choice Majority Action, a hybrid PAC recently formed on May 1 as a [legal affiliate](https://substack.com/redirect/a2524e09-87a0-40aa-a021-f1108b37d859?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of EDW Action. AIPAC [has used EDW Action ](https://substack.com/redirect/9b7e428c-8f6b-4bf3-8919-5d9a7600ae6d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)to shelter spending in several 2026 Democratic primary elections across the country already, and the same trend has followed in this race. DeGette also accepted a one-time $2,900 contribution [directly from AIPAC](https://substack.com/redirect/891ab880-07a7-4f20-87d4-84c98491b9db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in May 2022, but has since sworn off the lobby.
The AIPAC money has taken a circuitous route to television screens in Denver. AIPAC's United Democracy Project [donated](https://substack.com/redirect/d6b0f5d6-4ef4-450b-a027-eb9dc4145728?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) $350,000 to EDW Action on May 1 and $400,000 on May 20, after which EDW Action [transferred](https://substack.com/redirect/25a151f3-ab2b-4b73-8dfc-543a70ed8298?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) $876,000 to Pro-Choice Majority in three installments of $626,000, $100,000 and $150,000 on May 21, May 22 and May 29. Any funding EDW Action or Pro-Choice Majority secured after June 1 is not required to be disclosed until July 1, one day after Colorado's Tuesday primary election.
The EDW PAC [sent](https://substack.com/redirect/0631c011-3555-4e6b-a384-60c4513173c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) EDW Action Fund an additional $380,000 throughout the month of May.
PCM [spent](https://substack.com/redirect/d743a611-4418-428f-b3bd-729a2ae33825?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) roughly $460,000 in [ad buys](https://substack.com/redirect/33dbed5d-7789-4b1e-890f-dff6f9495e17?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) supporting DeGette in two dumps on June 16 and June 18 respectively, despite [reporting](https://substack.com/redirect/25a151f3-ab2b-4b73-8dfc-543a70ed8298?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) less than $38,000 total cash-on-hand as of May 31. Then, the PAC [dropped](https://substack.com/redirect/fc05c8a3-16a6-46cf-9789-e8934b033978?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) more than $530,000 on a pro-DeGette ad buy on June 22, only to trump that figure with another $550,000 on June 24 and 25. Those final buys bring PCM's year-to-date total spent either in support of DeGette or against Kiros over $1.5 million.
Lenny Young, a representative for both EDW Action and PCM explained that the two groups move cash between themselves and collaborate with other organizations when they support the same candidate. "Obviously there are groups out there who have their own priorities, who also happen to support the same women candidates we support. In those cases, it's clearly much more effective to combine resources to carry a message," he said in an email to Drop Site.
Project 218, another super PAC spending big behind DeGette, receives much of its funding from wealthy tech industry donors, as first [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/3ef47353-1a4d-4b3e-b3e9-2ef89e84fed5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the Colorado Sun. Project 218 [dumped](https://substack.com/redirect/9c97c25c-e383-4c9b-ab03-1070a7c3c489?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) $400,000 into [attack ads against Kiros](https://substack.com/redirect/19487166-609a-4553-a437-49625bbb8dac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on June 17 after receiving two massive $3.5 million and $630,000 [contributions](https://substack.com/redirect/327a5efe-d0e2-4864-b6fe-a11b8fab38c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from a 501(c)(4) organization called Democracy Matters on May 26 and May 20 respectively. Campaign finance laws do not require 501(c)(4)s, frequently referred to as "dark money" or "advocacy" groups, to disclose the sources of their funding.
Artificial intelligence, now the holy grail in Silicon Valley, is an especially hot button issue in Colorado amid a [glut](https://substack.com/redirect/26ac97a4-19b8-4456-8a48-ea962452995d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in data center construction along its portion of the I-25 corridor.
"When we're talking about the threat of AI, I think a lot of folks think about it as like the apocalypse of the robots," Kiros said in an interview with Drop Site News and the American Prospect. "It's actually a lot worse, just in that it gets absorbed into our military industrial complex and it makes one or two wrong decisions and now we're at a nuclear war with Russia."
Kiros said that a federal data center moratorium is imperative and should be used as a negotiation tactic to implement significant regulation of AI. She also believes that the government is not thinking nearly big enough about all the implications of the rapid artificial intelligence advancement we have seen over the last few years.
"I think it's also something that has motivated me into making sure that we sign on finally onto the UN's Declaration of Human Rights and guaranteeing the rights to housing and health care and nutritional food as basic rights in our Constitution. Because if, you know, AI changes work as we know it, and the social contract that we have is that if you work, then that contract is broken and you need to replace it with something else that protects people's dignity. And so this is going to change everything, and I don't think we have enough folks that are talking about it in a meaningful way."
DeGette could not be reached for comment. In discussing AI, DeGette has often focused on the energy demands and improving the grid. "After 20 years of stagnation, electricity demand is finally set to grow again, driven by everything from data centers to a resurgence in domestic manufacturing to vehicle electrification, America is demanding more electricity," she said in a [hearing](https://substack.com/redirect/bee753a8-06c9-45d7-8fc0-560cbbe6bc74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the House. "This increasing desire for electricity is a good thing... But as we celebrate these new industries being built in the United States, we must make sure our power grid is up to the task."
Kiros has campaigned with Hasan Piker in recent weeks and picked up a key endorsement from Sen. Bernie Sanders. Piker had been slated to host a rally for Kiros and Senate candidate Julie Gonzales, who is challenging Democratic incumbent Sen. John Hickenlooper, in Denver on Sunday June 14, but was blocked after various venues, including the Ogden Theatre, Reelworks, and Stanley Marketplace, canceled the events. Stanley Marketplace told Deep Singh Badeesh, one of the event organizers, that they were told it was "a neo-Nazi rally."
The speakers would make for an odd lineup at a Nazi rally: aside from the Turkish-American Muslim Piker, Reps. Justin Pearson and Donavan McKinney were also scheduled to speak and are both Black; Gonzales is Latina and Kiros emigrated from Tigray, Ethiopia. The rally was moved to the Capitol steps.

body:
5 months left until the midterm elections.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134260846/630642744/798536563?refcode=BLU_EM_LGC_2026-06-29_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzIwMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMjRmNDQyOS1lMDczLWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=h8_iEm8T-b_UfiY6XztItJGW3h33BEKVhrv6KZVGdJs=)
---
Peter, it's Hakeem Jeffries.

We are halfway through the year, with fewer than **5 months left** until the midterm elections.

So much has already happened this year, including an unprecedented attack on voting rights, an assault on healthcare and Donald Trump’s reckless and costly war of choice in the Middle East.

Gas prices continue to rise, grocery bills have doubled and Republicans are more worried about padding their $300 million war chest than ensuring Americans can afford to live.

**Despite Republicans’ incompetent leadership, this election will still be neck-and-neck, Peter**. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. subject: A candidate with the guts to stand up to the Oligarchy

body:
Let me say a few words as to why this race and your support is so important. | | | Peter, Thank you for the support you have been giving to progressive candidates throughout the country. Because of you our movement has won critical primary victories this year in New Jersey, Ohio, Pennsylvania, California, and most recently in New York. The message cannot be clearer: The American people are sick and tired of status quo politics and a corrupt campaign finance system which benefits only the rich and powerful. They want a government that represents all of us and not just a handful of billionaires. And they are supporting candidates who will do just that. In just a moment, I am going to ask you to make a contribution to Melat Kiros' campaign for Congress in Colorado. Melat is running a strong grassroots campaign against an establishment incumbent. In the last week alone she has faced more than $700,000 in outside spending. In other words, the establishment is doing everything possible to defeat her. But, if she has our financial support in these final days, she can win. Melat was born in Ethiopia, moved to America as a child and was raised in a working-class immigrant household. She understands that healthcare is a human right, that housing must be affordable, and that the billionaires and large corporations should not be allowed to buy our elections. And she has the courage to stand up for what is right: Melat was fired from her law firm for speaking out in defense of students protesting the genocide in Gaza, and she believes we should not be spending huge amounts of money to fund unconstitutional and illegal wars. As a member of Congress, she will vote to end all military support to the extremist government in Israel. [**If you are in a position to contribute to Melat's campaign, please split a contribution between her campaign and the Working Families Party who has endorsed her in this race.**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T99-T49G7arHKX9hzt9dijSu8T8TUJ8tVIvTNf9KlqYDkWThE2PfX717Xo5sbDOn2tUcr3EpOmWmkpp9gRggt-Hx92G3Jf1tGnRLiqwPedPr-az4IN9ZTecRoUSUFJlpD3r8-tjKcn7K12JO4Kwe2iJGJ2iOMSqVr0718R05xo1aF-WQf2-7LPeTaY-wZtEDFTRgOjL_CCOMWMwyOaxC7tYcOPpvQhdaa763olj4HrIxgDwFfimjUgvdMu9HLqKaLqIdIp8lyDTmK5hHTv5-usj0wRWKLnFZuozi4CU43vRCEzp4O8_a20l_bdfTZ2iib5sV7FQWWSIpH2z21w1mLNgNl8gVwCwDQSoeVxIhVE8lI/4rw/u70UCl2XTqGBNiZJop7yrg/h0/h001.wSnnXZMxu9Rsvi9fP2L-A6Ov2nJC4dnthUd2xDDRPh0) Let me say a few words as to why this race and your support is so important. Poll after poll shows that Americans understand that the U.S. is moving in the wrong direction. Today, we have unprecedented income and wealth inequality with the rich getting much richer while working families struggle to survive. We have a corrupt campaign finance system which allows billionaires to buy elections and undermine our democracy. Our health care system is broken and wildly expensive. We have a major housing crisis with 800,000 homeless and millions of families spending half their incomes or more on housing. People are deeply worried about the impact that AI and robotics will have on their lives. And on and on it goes. Now more than ever, we need candidates who have the guts to stand up to the Oligarchy and fight to bring meaningful improvement to people's lives. Melat is one of those candidates. Her primary is this week and, as I mentioned above, she is facing an obscene amount of outside spending — the kind we have seen in many primaries across the country over the past few months. So with time running out, I am once again asking for your financial support. **[If electing leaders with the guts to stand up to the billionaire class and large corporations trying to buy our elections is important to you, please split a contribution of $27 or whatever you can afford directly to Melat Kiros' campaign for Congress in Colorado today along with the Working Families Party who has endorsed her in this race.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T99-T49G7arHKX9hzt9dijSu8T8TUJ8tVIvTNf9KlqYDkWThE2PfX717Xo5sbDOn2tHmuw-GWehrM0Q9GiRtoD5UT0EjuYLFxc-INhAG1Oq1-qrL3uWJHiT2JTDFbWLIR6K1SkspAS80gkGzxuApfhO1Yztqg8AZqB8_mXy_2FefdgwLeiOUm6KA-MYZhBrbXxoWTd5U8PhbUajSeFDB2TGGdvFeYWC1GA1JOrvVpZuk92YPExzQXsAq0AUeiLm-UpBYDpiqnzQJC4v9jYjSftWkrU6VOY9ScbZku5OxwPsmxU_bpT54SNDOYFjyV7roweQw6SNm6L5gh295VLDZFy1mkdeoXjU6e8MCLgth8Dtf0/4rw/u70UCl2XTqGBNiZJop7yrg/h1/h001.uyf2P4jYwr0kXml1d5xfjrNQYhWtnXVkyy0cKxaIYO8)** **[Donate $27 »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T99-T49G7arHKX9hzt9dijSu8T8TUJ8tVIvTNf9KlqYDntyZCoqsaqldBkdoAuQLIEceh2IVGwkeiOwyj9SGXwioZhw7a7cb_z4TkebwfxeTcDx7MTB37NcD52YMoXP1w1ybiSQabHlXCYT-uGkSoRfYJtbLOPvvmzzScZ-HM_9RJd3pQhJ2xqiHrHgtQWpJoVHz--htOpOyKAufln8C4mB1S1ErnZ3cudxSMXALqCJAygk_8XnqjFnduEpcDoUSiyjWDSDdzIV8s6pYYRwuMbYPgLLj3-2OlhTnk2xTpIqc4slo-wnn3ePXj1SijPfLC_NcMgJfp-7Uc7UmGVD4R9PiqzaBio7UeDUpEES7kxZ3g/4rw/u70UCl2XTqGBNiZJop7yrg/h2/h001.ms2CLCzeerNmG2KYY9JdZQfKnTmCD6J4Tal-7Yw2xWc)** Sisters and brothers — our agenda is not the agenda of the Democratic establishment of this country. clean_body: Let me say a few words as to why this race and your support is so important. | | | Peter, Thank you for the support you have been giving to progressive candidates throughout the country. Because of you our movement has won critical primary victories this year in New Jersey, Ohio, Pennsylvania, California, and most recently in New York. The message cannot be clearer: The American people are sick and tired of status quo politics and a corrupt campaign finance system which benefits only the rich and powerful. They want a government that represents all of us and not just a handful of billionaires. And they are supporting candidates who will do just that. In just a moment, I am going to ask you to make a contribution to Melat Kiros' campaign for Congress in Colorado. Melat is running a strong grassroots campaign against an establishment incumbent. In the last week alone she has faced more than $700,000 in outside spending. In other words, the establishment is doing everything possible to defeat her. But, if she has our financial support in these final days, she can win. Melat was born in Ethiopia, moved to America as a child and was raised in a working-class immigrant household. She understands that healthcare is a human right, that housing must be affordable, and that the billionaires and large corporations should not be allowed to buy our elections. And she has the courage to stand up for what is right: Melat was fired from her law firm for speaking out in defense of students protesting the genocide in Gaza, and she believes we should not be spending huge amounts of money to fund unconstitutional and illegal wars. As a member of Congress, she will vote to end all military support to the extremist government in Israel. Let me say a few words as to why this race and your support is so important. Poll after poll shows that Americans understand that the U.S. is moving in the wrong direction. Today, we have unprecedented income and wealth inequality with the rich getting much richer while working families struggle to survive. We have a corrupt campaign finance system which allows billionaires to buy elections and undermine our democracy. Our health care system is broken and wildly expensive. We have a major housing crisis with 800,000 homeless and millions of families spending half their incomes or more on housing. People are deeply worried about the impact that AI and robotics will have on their lives. And on and on it goes. Now more than ever, we need candidates who have the guts to stand up to the Oligarchy and fight to bring meaningful improvement to people's lives. Melat is one of those candidates. Her primary is this week and, as I mentioned above, she is facing an obscene amount of outside spending — the kind we have seen in many primaries across the country over the past few months. So with time running out, I am once again asking for your financial support. Sisters and brothers — our agenda is not the agenda of the Democratic establishment of this country. And if we want a government that represents all of us and not just the 1%, then it is important we support candidates with the courage and the guts to stand with us in that struggle. body:
How JD Vance found his way back to faith

| | | |
---
| | | Fellow Patriot,
---
Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth.

He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him.

He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country.

That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt.

**That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,_Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith._**

Fellow Patriot, this book isn't just about JD Vance's story...

It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now.

So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together.

Young people face that pressure every single day.

They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is.

JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion.

He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back.

That's what _Communion_ is about...

And it gets to the heart of what so many families are watching happen in the lives of their children and grandchildren right now.

That's why Turning Point USA is reaching young people where this battle is actually being fought -- on campuses, in classrooms, and in a culture that keeps pressuring them to walk away from faith.

clean_body: How JD Vance found his way back to faith | | | | | | | Fellow Patriot, Faith is essential to the survival and success of America. Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth. He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him. He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country. That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt. That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith. Fellow Patriot, this book isn't just about JD Vance's story... It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now. So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together. Young people face that pressure every single day. They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is. JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion. He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back. That's what Communion is about... And it gets to the heart of what so many families are watching happen in the lives of their children and grandchildren right now. That's why Turning Point USA is reaching young people where this battle is actually being fought -- on campuses, in classrooms, and in a culture that keeps pressuring them to walk away from faith. Your support does far more than just send you a book... It helps Turning Point USA reach young people in the very places where faith is under attack. Because of supporters like you, students on more than 5,000 campuses are hearing something they may not hear anywhere else: a serious defense of faith, truth, and a life rooted in God. For many of them, that's the first time anyone has challenged the lies they have been fed. And for many of them, that's where their minds begin to change -- and so do their lives. Charlie believed the next generation was worth fighting for. By now, you've likely gotten a barrage of texts and emails -- from myself included -- about the upcoming "FEC end-of-quarter deadline." I get it. I know it can start to feel like just another reason to ask for money. So I wanted to take a moment to explain what this deadline means, and why it's different.
Every three months, campaigns are legally required to publicly disclose their fundraising totals. The report is available to everyone: journalists, supporters and opponents. It's one of the **biggest** indicators of where a race stands and a strong end-of-quarter showing carries significant weight.
**Here 's what's at stake in North Carolina, and why this deadline is so important to us. **The Republicans know this will be a tight race, even though we have a little bit of a lead at this point. The Senate Leadership Fund, the Senate GOP's official super PAC, has already committed $71 million to this race. A second GOP super PAC has committed another $17 million. That's nearly $100 million so far aimed at just our Senate seat. That's $100 million that will be used to spread lies about me and my record. There will be so many false attack ads launched that will reach voters early.
If we show weakness in our fundraising, this will give them incentive to flood the airwaves with tens of millions more to drown us out.
That's a risk we can't afford at this point in the race. We have to show everyone that our grassroots movement is thriving and unstoppable - that we have what it takes to build the strongest voter outreach and mobilization program our state has ever seen. When these FEC filings go public, everyone will be watching.
And so far, we've stood our ground. Thanks to the support from many of you, we launched our first two ads this month. Last quarter, we outraised my opponent by almost $9 million, and we did it with an average donation of less than $100.
North Carolina hasn't sent a Democrat to the U.S. Senate since 2008. But the best chance to flip the Senate and take back Washington relies on us.
Our people-powered movement has proven that this race is winnable. And the GOP knows that.
That's why this deadline is so important. When our report goes live, everyone will be watching. This filing will signal whether we are vulnerable to even more attacks.
We have been building an amazing movement of grassroots donors and volunteers. Now is the time to show it.
I appreciate each and every one of you in this fight. Thank you for [chipping in](https://substack.com/redirect/68022e70-92c9-4926-b698-094b7750b3a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a few dollars when you could, [volunteering](https://substack.com/redirect/615ec01f-d0e9-4643-9515-343de684a564?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to knock on doors or just staying updated on this race. I am grateful for it all.

Thank you for a few dollars when you could, to knock on doors or just staying updated on this race. I am grateful for it all. | | | | | | | (C) 2026 Roy Cooper PO Box 1190, Raleigh, NC 27602 ? ?

# [The Trump account hack that quietly builds your kid decades of untouchable wealth](https://substack.com/redirect/69e2b187-0c1a-46f5-bae9-6b4dececb055?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Parents can treat new Trump accounts **[as prefunding for child retirement IRAs under age 18 allowing Roth conversions](https://substack.com/redirect/69a1c299-870c-4d7c-9776-53ff59c969bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in low or zero tax years so money compounds tax free for decades, while avoiding required minimum distributions later.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/69e2b187-0c1a-46f5-bae9-6b4dececb055?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Accounts Act As IRA** : They function as traditional IRA for children under 18 enabling Roth conversions when the child pays no taxes and sidestepping required minimum distributions in retirement.
* **Withdrawals Follow IRA Rules** : Funds become accessible penalty free but not tax free from age 18 for education first home or 1000 dollars in annual emergency expenses.
* **Experts Favor Roth Strategy** : Financial planners say the only reason to use Trump accounts is planning the Roth conversion otherwise 529 plans or taxable brokerage accounts work better for college or flexible goals.
* **Without Conversion Tax Bomb** : Funds left untouched turn into taxed income at withdrawal creating a tax bomb after decades of growth.

# [Detroit's darkest hour and the decline no one can stop](https://substack.com/redirect/69e2b187-0c1a-46f5-bae9-6b4dececb055?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
A perfect storm of slowing population growth and high prices points to **[a shrinking US auto market by 2040](https://substack.com/redirect/4f1cf11a-e724-40f0-9ac9-c3f7ecd55e82?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as Volkswagen plans 100,000 job cuts and plant closures, Lucid and Rivian implement layoffs, and Polestar is banned from future US sales.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/69e2b187-0c1a-46f5-bae9-6b4dececb055?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Bain Predicts Volume Drop** : Analysts expect auto sales to fall more than 2 million units by 2040 due to below replacement fertility rates, restricted immigration and changing consumer behavior with fewer young drivers.
* **VW Targets Cost Savings** : **[Volkswagen will cut](https://substack.com/redirect/807057ad-e751-48ac-bd4a-3b16ac8e8911?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** 15 percent of its workforce or 100,000 jobs, close four German plants and reduce planned investments by 15 percent to 130 billion euros.
* **Lucid Rivian Cut Staff** : **[Lucid reduces](https://substack.com/redirect/04be4548-f85e-46b9-ae18-844957464e11?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** 18 percent of US workforce and eliminates COO role for 158 million dollars savings while **[Rivian lays off](https://substack.com/redirect/52210a20-c045-417c-a841-e23ba122b9fe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** hundreds amid billions in annual losses.
* **Polestar US Sales Halted** : The China linked company is **[blocked from selling 2027 model vehicles](https://substack.com/redirect/c7313375-8ae8-42b5-b883-bf5c1f3809d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in the US under connected vehicles rules citing security risks but can sell current inventory.

* * *
* * *
# [China just matched Anthropic in cyber as the AI arms race resets again](https://substack.com/redirect/69e2b187-0c1a-46f5-bae9-6b4dececb055?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Chinese Zhipu AI model has matched Anthropic's Mythos in finding security bugs, narrowing the U.S. gap as open-weight systems surge and **[U.S. restrictions raise fears Beijing gains cyberwarfare edge.](https://substack.com/redirect/fb136608-0388-43e2-919f-8596e5b7c7d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/69e2b187-0c1a-46f5-bae9-6b4dececb055?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Z.ai Equals Bug Detection** : GLM-5.2 bested Claude Opus 4.8 in tests and matches Mythos when instructed while ranking among the 10 most used AI models.
* **Open Weight Raises Risks** : Unlike restricted U.S. models the Chinese system can be downloaded modified and run freely making it ideal for hackers and businesses alike.
* **360 Tool Matches Mythos** : Chinese firm released Tulongfeng comparable to Mythos alarming officials on cyberwarfare balance after U.S. limits on GPT-5.6 and Mythos.
* **Policy Critique Intensifies** : Critics say banning U.S. models while selling chips to China incentivizes cheaper open-weight Chinese alternatives undermining American industry.

# [Top Apple Vision Pro exec just defected to OpenAI in shocking exit](https://substack.com/redirect/69e2b187-0c1a-46f5-bae9-6b4dececb055?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Apple vice president Paul Meade who led Vision Pro and upcoming AI smart glasses **[is leaving for OpenAI hardware amid John Ternus elevation to CEO](https://substack.com/redirect/73b3dae6-5fb9-41e8-b2e2-1c0b7e2092a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and hardware team shakeup.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/69e2b187-0c1a-46f5-bae9-6b4dececb055?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Meade Led Key Projects** : He oversaw Vision Pro development and AI powered smart glasses planned for launch next year as the costly headset failed to gain traction.
* **OpenAI Expands Hardware Push** : The move aligns with OpenAI work alongside Jony Ive on a calm AI device more peaceful than an iPhone to rival Meta wearables.
* **Context Of Leadership Changes** : Departure tied to Ternus decision to reshape hardware engineering leaving some vice presidents feeling demoted.
* **Apple Seeks Affordable Options** : Company hopes cheaper smart glasses will help compete after Vision Pro struggled commercially.

* * *
* * *
# [Qualcomm CEO predicts AI glasses will turn Americans into walking cameras](https://substack.com/redirect/69e2b187-0c1a-46f5-bae9-6b4dececb055?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon says ultra-fast 6G networks will transform everyday Americans into walking cameras as[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/287dd4cf-ac90-4adb-9dfa-a87f2555ab63?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[AI-powered smart glasses stream everything they see and hear](https://substack.com/redirect/287dd4cf-ac90-4adb-9dfa-a87f2555ab63?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to models for instant intelligence.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/69e2b187-0c1a-46f5-bae9-6b4dececb055?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **6G Networks Transform Users** : Ultra-fast connections let smart glasses send real-time video and audio to AI models that interact and deliver intelligence immediately.
* **Glasses Offer Prime Real Estate** : Devices sit close to eyes ears and mouth allowing AI to see hear and read what users do with rapid processing.
* **Meta Leads Smart Glasses Push** : Company invests heavily with other firms like Google and Apple developing AI models while Qualcomm partners to support computing needs.
* **Qualcomm Evolves Beyond Chips** : Firm expands into data centers AI software and acquisitions like Modular marking shift from traditional smartphone focus.

* * *
* * *
# [From Taylor Swift seats to Amtrak rides, bots just crushed you again](https://substack.com/redirect/69e2b187-0c1a-46f5-bae9-6b4dececb055?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Automated bots **[snap up concert and train tickets in seconds](https://substack.com/redirect/5e3d90b7-b588-4784-a87b-84eb4befdf2e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** before reselling at markups meaning genuine fans lose out as South Korea and China tighten rules yet supply limits and scalpers remain bigger issues.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/69e2b187-0c1a-46f5-bae9-6b4dececb055?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Bots Win Ticket Wars** : Fans compete against programs that buy seats instantly distorting access for concerts and train reservations with 65 percent of Singapore survey respondents citing unfairness.

After Tuesday’s deadline, two things are going to happen:
**FIRST, my team and I are going to make a big decision.**
On Wednesday morning, we’re going to sit down and look at our fundraising numbers for the quarter. If we meet our end-of-quarter goal? That’s our green light to scale up our efforts and keep investing in efforts to reach undecided voters and protect this district.
But if we fall short? That’s a sign that we need to seriously consider reorganizing our funds — and that means less digital ads online, fewer undecided voters reached, and ultimately, _less momentum for this campaign._
**THEN, our fundraising numbers are going to go public. **
That means that anyone — _including our general election opponents_ — can take a look at our fundraising numbers for this quarter. They’re going to be poring over our data, looking for any sign of vulnerability or weakness in this campaign that they can exploit and use to defeat us in November.
**But if we meet our fundraising goal, they won’t find a single one.**
That’s why Tuesday’s deadline is so important — because our ability to defend Oregon’s 6th District is on the line.

Hi there, this is Omar — Mai's husband.

Mai doesn't know I'm sending this. But with her first big deadline coming up on Tuesday, I wanted to step in and tell you why I believe in her — not as a candidate, but as the person I've built a life with.

I work 12-hour shifts in the auto industry. I'm the son of a Mexican immigrant. So when Mai talks about families living paycheck to paycheck, about the squeeze working people are under, about a system that asks the most from the people who have the least — that's not just a talking point in our house.

What I've learned about Mai in all our years together is that she shows up for people without being asked and without expecting anything back. It's just who she is. I've watched her do it for our neighbors, for families in our community, for people who will never know her name. And I watch her do it for this campaign every single day — long hours, hard choices, and a refusal to cut the one corner that would make it all easier.

She will not take corporate PAC money. Not a dime. No matter how much harder that makes the math.

That's the difference voters are getting in this race. And on Tuesday, when our fundraising numbers go public, the whole political world is going to see whether a campaign built that way can really compete.

**[Mai is using every minute to make sure we're in a strong position. I just wanted to do my part.
