| [](https://substack.com/redirect/657723ca-9b62-45e5-8766-523eebb60327?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The U.S. Treasury Department has permanently barred from the banking industry a former Quontic Bank mortgage officer who originated dozens of home loans for rural Maine properties that were later converted into illicit Chinese marijuana grow houses.
The Maine Wire was the first -- and remains the only -- media outlet to report on the financial schemes ungirding the Chinese cannabis empire that blossomed in Maine beginning in 2020, including Quontic Bank and the now defunct Money Tree Capital Markets.
Steven Ho, who held the title of vice president and senior mortgage lending officer at Quontic Bank in Astoria, New York, agreed to a consent order issued by the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, a bureau of the Treasury Department that charters and examines federal savings associations like Quontic. Ho signed the order on May 7. Leslie A. Chumbley, the OCC's director for special supervision, made it final on May 18.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e294dcc9-e6ee-4d62-a029-5a1bf36419c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Subscribe to the only outlet in New England investigating taxpayer-subsidized organized crime. It's free!
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Ror07CuD0KpNMkPOvzeQfwB4jg1b1N9bJKOOn1px28w?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=204140688)
The order does what the federal banking laws call a prohibition: it bars Ho, for life, from participating "in any manner in the conduct of the affairs" of any insured bank, credit union, farm credit institution, or federal banking regulator. The ban lifts only if Ho someday obtains the written consent of both the OCC and the institution's own regulator -- a permission that is rarely sought and rarely granted.
Under the terms of the consent decree, Ho did not admit to any unethical or criminal actions whatsoever. Ho consented to the order "without admitting or denying any wrongdoing."
Between July 2014 and January 2023, according to the order, Ho originated mortgages for Quontic, a self-described "adaptive digital bank." During that time, the Comptroller found, Ho "worked with third-party mortgage brokers that were not approved in accordance with the Bank's policy," then "concealed his dealings with these brokers from Bank decisionmakers" and kept their involvement out of the bank's mortgage system. The result, the order says, was that Quontic "generated inaccurate mortgage documentation, including loan estimates and closing disclosures, that did not disclose the role of the brokers or the associated fees."
That was only the beginning. The OCC found that Ho "participated in the falsification of information contained in Uniform Residential Lending Applications," the standard mortgage form known in the industry as a Form 1003. The falsified information, the order says, included "borrowers' income, job titles, and employment history," along with supporting documents such as "profit and loss statements, verifications of employment letters, and letters of explanation."
In other words, OCC says the loan files were cooked.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Ror07CuD0KpNMkPOvzeQfwB4jg1b1N9bJKOOn1px28w?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=204140688)
The OCC determination adds a new perspective to what Ho, who was originally born in Taiwan, told me in a Jan. 2024 phone interview, when he bragged that Quontic's mortgage profits increased by 1000 percent during Covid-19.
The order goes further. Ho, it says, "participated in the concealment of unemployment benefits from Bank decisionmakers in loan applications by directing borrowers to open new bank accounts, provide bank statements for other accounts, or delay submitting bank statements." When obvious problems surfaced -- "inconsistencies in borrower employment, income, and other related application documentation" -- Ho "failed to escalate" them to the people at the bank who were supposed to be checking. And in perhaps the most damning single sentence in the document, the Comptroller found that Ho "guided borrowers and brokers on what to put in loan application documentation to avoid scrutiny from Bank decisionmakers."
He was paid for it. The order states plainly that Ho "received commissions for loans closed, including those containing inaccurate information."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6f528f0e-3cb9-471c-845a-9109bc14a4ba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Critically, Quontic Bank is a financial institution that appeals specifically -- if not exclusively -- to foreign nationals looking to acquire property in the United States. Quontic's website homepage currently touts mortgages for non-citizens, and the bank offers special loans for foreign nationals. Although the OCC consent decree does not say whether Ho's alleged deception and fraud were aimed at helping foreigners acquire American houses and land, it seems likely given Quontic's customer base and Ho's own [admission](https://substack.com/redirect/558c4dc0-1e82-41f2-bf89-7f567460470b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about his targeting of Chinese language communities.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f29e2340-4d0a-4b99-a608-b72897c58f2f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
According to the OCC, after Ho decided to leave Quontic to start his own mortgage venture, he raided the bank on his way out the door.
"Without approval from the Bank," the order says, Ho "transferred, and was aware that other Bank employees transferred, confidential customer and business information of the Bank to support his new mortgage venture."
**[[RELATED: How the U.S. Treasury Department Helps Chinese Organized Crime Transform American Homes Into Drug Dens...]](https://substack.com/redirect/9eb00914-1ebd-4ccf-848d-2b8e10e94097?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
That information was not trivial. It included, the order says, "the mortgage loan data for thousands of Bank customers such as the names, addresses, social security numbers, credit scores, and citizenship status of those Bank customers," as well as the bank's loan-investor information and its internal policies and procedures.
Join 27k New Englanders who get their investigative news and multimedia content from The Robinson Report...
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Ror07CuD0KpNMkPOvzeQfwB4jg1b1N9bJKOOn1px28w?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=204140688)
Ho shared all of it, the Comptroller found, "with non-Bank employees via unsecured email," leaving the bank unable to give its own customers "clear and conspicuous notice" that their most sensitive data had been disclosed.
The OCC concluded that Ho's conduct "resulted in inaccurate statements entered into the Bank's books and records, concealed material information from Bank decisionmakers, and increased the Bank's financial and other risks."
By the agency's reckoning, he "engaged in violations of law and regulation," "breached his fiduciary duties to the Bank," realized "financial gain or other benefit," and "demonstrated personal dishonesty" -- the legal triggers that allow a federal regulator to throw someone out of banking for good.
By signing the order, Ho waived his right to a hearing, his right to appeal, and his right to contest the order's validity in any court. The settlement resolves the OCC's own potential case against him, but it leaves every other door open. The agency reserved the right to use these same findings "in future enforcement actions to establish a pattern of misconduct," and it made clear that nothing in the document limits "any other representatives of the United States or agencies thereof, including the Department of Justice, to bring other actions deemed appropriate."
The OCC order never mentions Maine, marijuana, or illicit activity conducted by loan recipients. But both Quontic Bank and Ho played a significant role -- unknowingly, Ho says -- in securing financing for the sprawling network of Chinese cannabis grow houses in Maine. According to Maine deed registry records, more than 75 Chinese cannabis grows were financed using Quontic Bank. Almost half of those mortgages bear Steven Ho's name as the mortgage officer. Those loans accounts for almost all of Quontic's lending activity in Maine.
What the OCC describes -- falsified incomes, manufactured employment letters, hidden unemployment checks, coached borrowers, and straw-buyer paperwork engineered to slip past the bank's underwriters -- is, almost line for line, the mechanism The Maine Wire began documenting in November 2023, when this outlet became the only news organization in the country to investigate Quontic Bank's role in financing Maine's Chinese organized-crime cannabis epidemic.
The pattern of behavior is precisely what would be beneficial to a transnational organized crime syndicate looking to rapidly acquire property in Maine for the purposes of cultivating and trafficking illicit cannabis.
In the phone interview, Ho said he did not know whether the loan documents OCC alleged contained fraudulent documents involved properties in Maine.
"I was not privy to those details," said Ho.
All told, Quontic financed more than $15 million worth of residential mortgages for homes in rural Maine after 2020, despite having done almost no lending in the state before recreational cannabis was legalized here that year.
The two loan officers whose names appeared on the majority of those Maine files were Hon and his colleague Ying-Chan Weng, a Chinese national who attended Zhejiang University. In 2021, as the loans piled up, a mortgage-industry trade publication celebrated Ho's "meteoric rise" under the headline "Top Originator: From a novice to a non-QM pro."
**[[RELATED: Triad Weed: One NYC Bank Financed More Than 50 Illicit Chinese Marijuana Grow Houses in Rural Maine...]](https://substack.com/redirect/98ad2f9c-d674-4dde-a135-8a63599dadd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Ho hinted that he disagreed with the OCC's conclusions and that there was more to the story that he would not share based on the advice of his attorney.
"There's unfortunately a lot more to it that I do not, I do not feel I can share that, you know, without speaking to council," said Ho.
The properties Ho financed, according to mortgage documents filed with the various county deed registries, are scattered across the map of rural Maine.
One in Thorndike has been investigated as a suspected grow by the Waldo County Sheriff's Office. According to the former sheriff, even the FBI had inquired about that property. One in Winterport caught fire because the marijuana operation inside was drawing too much electricity, leaving a family home gutted. Another in Rumford sits boarded up, reeking of cannabis, under investigation by local police.
Maine law enforcements -- always sheriffs, never the Maine State Police -- have also raided Quontic Bank-financed properties at 34 Clover Lane in Whitefield (owned by Hongxia Kuang), 9 Riverside Drive in Norridgewock (owned by Hai Bin Cen), 204 Rome Road in Mercer (owned by Yong Yuan Wu), 107 Perkins Street in Norridgewock (owned by Patrick Yam), and 555 Belfast Road in Freedom (owned by Austin Zhen).
[](https://substack.com/redirect/24c663bf-c6b3-4ea7-81cb-70acd771745c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
None of this would have been possible at scale without the federal program at the center of it. Quontic is a community development financial institution, or CDFI -- a designation Congress created in 1994 to push banks to lend in underserved and immigrant communities, and one that comes wrapped in taxpayer support.
Quontic received its CDFI status in 2015.
[Share The Robinson Report](https://substack..Bie8GjF7XuhrZAlNIJHld2DpTW0rfteKXy4SFdVMYa0?)
Federal records show the bank collected more than $3 million in grants beginning in September 2020, money drawn from a $20 million "rapid response" tranche of CDFI funding rushed out during the pandemic, and that taxpayers subsidized 373 of its loans.
The CDFI rules also let Quontic do what conventional banks cannot: lend to borrowers who are not U.S. citizens, who cannot document regular income, and who source their down payments and closing costs from third parties -- every one of which is a feature a transnational criminal organization looking to launder money into American real estate would find useful, and all of which Quontic advertised openly on its website.
There's no evidence laid out in the consent decree that Quontic Bank was aware of the activity that would later occur at the properties they financed. And there's never been any accusation of wrongdoing leveled against Quontic or any of its current leadership.
The bank was started by visionary Steven Schnall in 2009, but Schnall [died](https://substack.com/redirect/1475d63e-3f3b-420a-95cc-83f9857d4332?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in a random motorcycle accident while on his way back from a biking trip to Canada.
In a phone interview with The Maine Wire in January 2024, Ho was candid about how good the business had been and how he found his customers. He described targeting the Chinese-speaking community directly.
"My marketing is towards the Chinese community, and because I speak Chinese, so when someone comes to me for a loan and I help them based on, you know, what they can qualify for because of the community that they belong in," Ho said.
"One person refers to another person," he said.
He summed up the strategy with a fishing metaphor: "You go fish where the fish are."
The fishing was lucrative. Ho recalled Quontic's explosive growth in the year the Maine loans began.
"I remember, in one of the meetings, the company grew 1,000 percent, which was incredible," he said. "It was, like, you know, some crazy number." NYT: Trump Leans on Congress to Address His False Claims of Voter Fraud [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=062926_2&amount=25]
President Trump is trying everything his advisors can think of -- including blocking a bipartisan housing relief bill -- to press Congress to advance stalled legislation that purports to address his often-repeated -- and equally debunked -- claims of widespread election fraud. There are stats from the conservative, right-wing Heritage Foundation below that prove it.
The SAVE America Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights and passed the U.S. House of Representatives. Now Trump and his MAGA minions are meeting with U.S. Senators, scheming for ways to get this bill through the Senate ahead of November's midterms.
This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law, folks.
PITCH IN $35 RIGHT NOW TO STOP THE SAVE AMERICA ACT NOW ➜ [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=062926_2&amount=35]
Don’t be fooled by the name. This bill would force every voter to present specific types of proof of citizenship to register -- something millions of eligible Americans don’t have on hand. And that’s the point. The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise up to 11 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”
Team, the consequences of a bill like this passing would be catastrophic for our democracy. Chip in with $35 or whatever you can today to stop the SAVE AMERICA Act and other voter suppression bills from becoming law >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=062926_2&amount=35]

How do we know non-citizen voting is a made up problem? Because red states and conservative-leaning institutions have spent millions in taxpayer money and donor dollars searching for it and finding minimal results.
For example: The pro-Trump Heritage Foundation -- an organization that has funded anti-voting initiatives for decades -- maintains a database of "election crimes." Their own records only list 24 instances of non-citizens voting in U.S. elections from 2003 to 2023 . In other words -- 20 years of elections, millions of votes, and only 24 alleged non-citizen voters.
Reuters has a fuller accounting in recent reporting. Florida, for example, spent millions investigating voter fraud and creating a new state department to oversee election security. They've only prosecuted two non-citizens for voting since 2022. North Carolina said they found nine non-citizens registered to vote out of 7.7 million voters. Utah recently investigated their entire voter roll of 2.1 million registered voters and found one registered non-citizen who never attempted to vote.
The conservative CATO Institute says it best: " These investigations affirm what is simply common sense. People largely aren’t willing to risk their status in the United States — the land of economic opportunity — for the ability to cast one more vote out of hundreds of thousands or millions in a state and hundreds of millions in the country. "
Team, the lies aren't going to stop, but we can push back and make sure bills like this abomination never pass. Pitch in $35 or however much you can to stand against voter suppression bills in Congress and beyond >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=062926_2&amount=35]

This weekend, someone with hate in their heart picked up a phone, called Child Protective Services, and falsely reported that Pete Buttigieg was abusing his four-year-old twins.
It was a lie. A complete fabrication, built on a story about some woman who supposedly met Pete at a conference in Alabama -- a town he has never set foot in. But that's all it takes. The call triggered a process. CPS and the police showed up at his home in Michigan. His kids were sent to their grandparents'. Pete was told he could not be alone with his own children until they'd been interviewed by strangers. For twenty-four hours, this family had no idea what he was even accused of. This wasn't just an attack on Pete Buttigieg. It was an attempt to make public service hurt. That's the point.
Twenty-four hours. He called it among the darkest of his life. And as a father, I believe him -- because I've been sitting in my own rage about this for two days, and they're not even my kids.
Here's what you need to understand about Pete Buttigieg. The man is calm. He is level-headed to a fault -- the kind of person who keeps his voice even when everyone around him is losing it. So when *that* guy tells you about the rage and the sadness he felt, when *that* guy says someone "dragged our children into this," you should feel your stomach turn. Because it takes a lot to rattle Pete Buttigieg, and somebody found the one thing that would do it. They did it on purpose. They did it during Pride Month, right after he posted photos of his family for Father's Day. That's not an accident.
There are about ten different rants in me right now. How we protect LGBTQ parents from this kind of targeted cruelty. How the disgusting anti-Pride rhetoric coming out of the MAGA movement this month is a permission slip for exactly for cruelty like this. All of it is worth writing. But I want to talk about the part that scares me most, because it's the quiet part nobody says out loud.
**This is how they pick us off.**
Good people -- talented people, people who actually have something to give to their community, their city, their country -- these are the people who watch what happened to Pete and decide it's not worth it. I said the same thing when Melissa Hortman was assassinated in her own home in Minnesota last year. Every time one of these things happens, somewhere out there a good person who was *this close* to running for school board, for city council, for the state house, quietly decides to sit it out. Who could blame them?
* * *

Just $8/month makes a huge difference:](https://substack.com/redirect/4a571312-f4c1-44be-8559-1509178472bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

* * *
I'll be honest with you. When I told my wife I wanted to write about this -- that I wanted to get into it with my buddy Adam Mockler on our Saturday show -- she asked me not to. She didn't want something like this to come for us, for our son, for our family. And you know what? That's not paranoia. That's a completely legitimate fear. I sat with it. I almost didn't write this, because writing it elevates it, and elevating it is what these people want.
But here's the thing about me: when I feel that fear, I tend to steer into the skid. I know not everybody is built that way, and I will *always* tell people to do what's right for them and their family first. No rant is worth your kid.
But understand what's happening if we all flinch at once.
You ever wonder why it feels like our politics is overrun with psychopaths and grifters and losers? It's not an accident. It is an intentional process of selection. Every assassination, every threat, every swatting, every bogus CPS report quietly filters out another decent person. There is an entire class of people who feel no shame, who don't care who they hurt, who aren't trying to *accomplish* anything -- and those people are not scared off by any of this. They're falling over themselves to run. They'll bend every rule, break every law, abuse every campaign finance loophole, go on TV and say the most vile thing they can think of, because cruelty is the product. That's how you get Trump. That's how you get all of them. And every time a decent person decides it's too dangerous to step up, the field gets handed a little more completely to the worst people in America.
I don't want these people to win.
Whether it's Melissa Hortman, a Minnesota elected member of Congress murdered in cold blood in her own home; or Alex Pretti, a thirty-seven-year-old ICU nurse, gunned down by federal agents as he stood in the street recording them and trying to help a woman they'd knocked down; or someone trying to take Pete Buttigieg's children from him over a lie, the objective is the same: they want you to hesitate. They want you scared to show up to a No Kings protest. Scared to pull out your phone and record ICE. Scared to put your name on a ballot. That's the point. We cannot accept this.
We cannot hand this country over to people who do not care about the rest of us, who aren't interested in building anything, who only know how to burn it down. When we withdraw, when we go quiet, when we get scared -- that *is* them winning. That's the whole game.
So I'm proud of Pete Buttigieg. I'm sorry it happened to him, to Chasten, to those two little kids. I can't imagine it. But I am so damn grateful he told the story, and even more grateful that he's staying in this fight. Because silence is part of the strategy. If enough good people stop speaking, stop organizing, stop running for office, stop showing up... they don't even have to beat us. We surrender. That is why this moment demands from all of us, the exact opposite -- people who will steer into the skid, who will refuse to stop recording, who will relentlessly hold these monsters accountable, who will call it what it is, and who will not let them take this country away from us.
Don't let them win.

Who could blame them? I'll be honest with you. When I told my wife I wanted to write about this -- that I wanted to get into it with my buddy Adam Mockler on our Saturday show -- she asked me not to. She didn't want something like this to come for us, for our son, for our family. And you know what? That's not paranoia. That's a completely legitimate fear. I sat with it. I almost didn't write this, because writing it elevates it, and elevating it is what these people want. But here's the thing about me: when I feel that fear, I tend to steer into the skid. I know not everybody is built that way, and I will always tell people to do what's right for them and their family first. No rant is worth your kid. But understand what's happening if we all flinch at once. You ever wonder why it feels like our politics is overrun with psychopaths and grifters and losers? It's not an accident. It is an intentional process of selection. Every assassination, every threat, every swatting, every bogus CPS report quietly filters out another decent person. There is an entire class of people who feel no shame, who don't care who they hurt, who aren't trying to accomplish anything -- and those people are not scared off by any of this. They're falling over themselves to run. They'll bend every rule, break every law, abuse every campaign finance loophole, go on TV and say the most vile thing they can think of, because cruelty is the product. That's how you get Trump. That's how you get all of them. And every time a decent person decides it's too dangerous to step up, the field gets handed a little more completely to the worst people in America. I don't want these people to win. Whether it's Melissa Hortman, a Minnesota elected member of Congress murdered in cold blood in her own home; or Alex Pretti, a thirty-seven-year-old ICU nurse, gunned down by federal agents as he stood in the street recording them and trying to help a woman they'd knocked down; or someone trying to take Pete Buttigieg's children from him over a lie, the objective is the same: they want you to hesitate. They want you scared to show up to a No Kings protest. Scared to pull out your phone and record ICE. Scared to put your name on a ballot. That's the point. We cannot accept this. We cannot hand this country over to people who do not care about the rest of us, who aren't interested in building anything, who only know how to burn it down. When we withdraw, when we go quiet, when we get scared -- that is them winning. That's the whole game. So I'm proud of Pete Buttigieg. I'm sorry it happened to him, to Chasten, to those two little kids. I can't imagine it. But I am so damn grateful he told the story, and even more grateful that he's staying in this fight. Because silence is part of the strategy. If enough good people stop speaking, stop organizing, stop running for office, stop showing up... they don't even have to beat us. We surrender. That is why this moment demands from all of us, the exact opposite -- people who will steer into the skid, who will refuse to stop recording, who will relentlessly hold these monsters accountable, who will call it what it is, and who will not let them take this country away from us. Don't let them win. Mike Nellis is a Democratic strategist and entrepreneur who has raised over $1 billion for Democratic campaigns and causes. He 's the founder of Authentic.org, an award-winning fundraising and advertising agency, and a former Senior Advisor to Vice President Kamala Harris. name: Ernest Lineberger
subject: Ernest Lineberger Supports Steven Shook for U.S. House of Representatives (Texas Congressional District 26) ​
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lineberger for US Congress
body:
[image: image.png]

With the primary election over, we need to fully align our support to send
Steven Shook as our representative to the U.S. House. We need to do this
for ourselves, for our community and for our country.

*We as a nation are in big trouble.*

This isn’t news unless you live in the Republican bubble (and a lot of
people do). Our national power and conscience have been taken over by a
very elite class of billionaires. They had a plan and they made it happen.

Now, the Trump administration is wielding chaos, corruption, cruelty with
impunity, while we as a nation suffer the consequences.

You know what I’m talking about. DOGE cuts to government organizations –
starting with the Inspectors General who are our guard for fraud and
wrongdoing. Blowing up multiple boats in the Caribbean and Pacific rather
than following legal procedures. Starting a war with Iran even when Iran
was on the verge of making the exact deal we were seeking. Sending ICE
enforcement platoons into our communities with violence, death and fear.
Gross mistreatment of people. All the while doing nothing to improve the
lives of Americans, working people, farmers, manufacturers, small
businesses, etc.

*They don’t care!* They don’t care about us or our quality of life.

Who are ‘They’? President Trump, his administration, the Republican
majority congress, and others who are only after the enrichment they can
grab for themselves and the power they can wield.

*We need a better Congress!* One with a Democratic majority that cares
about our nation and our people. One that will put real checks on the
executive overreach of the Trump administration – taking back the power of
the tariffs and war powers and more.

We are losing at the whims of President Donald Trump. We need to replace
his congressional protectors with real statesmen (and women).

*For Texas U.S. Congressional District 26, our Democratic Nominee is Steven
Shook. *

*[image: image.png]*

Today, I am asking you to continue that work by joining me in supporting
Steven Shook for Congress.
Steven and I share many common positions on policy, mostly oriented to
serve the people and do what is right, while pushing back on MAGA
Republican / Heritage Foundation shenanigans. Some of the key priority
areas include:

*Healthcare Affordability & Access*

*Lowering the Cost of Living*

*Education & Property Tax Relief*

*Social Security & Retirement Security*

*Public Safety & Gun Violence Prevention*

*Energy & Grid Reliability*

*Economic Fairness & Workers’ Rights*

*Civil Rights & Equal Protection*

*Immigration & Border Policy*

*Government Accountability & Democracy*

*Foreign Policy & Humanitarian Values*

Steven has built an impressive career in the medical profession where he
has served people directly, seen their needs and learned of many issues
that need to be addressed. Learn more about Steven Shook and his
congressional priorities at his campaign website:

Steven Shook for Congress 2026 - People Over Politics!
<https://shookforcongress2026.com/>

I’m certain that you will want to support Steven Shook in this 2026
campaign against the incumbent Trump supporting, truth twisting, careless
and harmful representative, Brandon Gill.

You can donate using link Steven Shook — Donate via ActBlue
<https://secure.actblue.com/donate/steven-shook-2>
You can join the team at link Steven Shook Congressional Campaign Volunteer
& Supporter Onboarding
<https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfnbygWmYCI8IVnP0BxgSvY0uVuxctPozZcVx8_NnuphkBz5w/viewform>
You can sign up to receive updates or send a message to the Shook campaign
using the campaign website Steven Shook for Congress 2026 - People Over
Politics! <https://shookforcongress2026.com/>

*Steven is focused on people over politics*, on showing up, listening, and
building a campaign rooted in real conversations with voters.

I believe Steven is a good candidate and a good person for this moment. He
has the work ethic, the grassroots commitment, and the ability to bring
people together that TX-26 needs right now.

He understands that this district includes working families, small towns,
fast-growing suburbs, rural communities, and people who feel ignored by
Washington. He is running to represent all of them.

That matters.

This general election will not be easy, but TX-26 deserves a real choice.
We cannot build that choice by staying divided, sitting on the sidelines,
or waiting until the final weeks of the campaign.

*Steven has my full support*, and I hope he will earn yours too.

That is why I am asking you to join me in supporting Steven Shook today.
Sign up, share his message, volunteer when you can, introduce him to people
in your community, or make a contribution if you are able.

Here is one thing you can do today, please forward this message to three
people who care about stronger representation for TX-26. Personal
recommendations and discussions make a big difference.

Thank you again for believing in me and supporting our work.

*Please join me in helping Steven build the campaign TX-26 needs.*

I’m Ernest Lineberger, retired naval officer and engineer, two-time
candidate for US House (Texas CD26), now putting my full support behind our
Democratic Nominee, Steven Shook. My campaign is closing after my recent
primary loss. I’m using my platform to help Steven make the difference for
all of us before I close down my campaign committee soon. If you want to
help me with final bills, you can still do so for a short time by donating
through LinebergerforUScongress.com
<https://www.linebergerforuscongress.com/>

One Community – Diverse But Not Divided.

Putting People’s Needs First!

Your friend and neighbor,

Ernest Lineberger

Paid for by Lineberger for US Congress

©2026 Lineberger for US Congress, all rights reserved.

https://www.linebergerforuscongress.com

Our mailing address is:

Lineberger for US Congress

PO Box 116668

Carrollton, TX

75011-6668

We hate to see you go, but if you believe you received this email in error,
or you no longer wish to receive our emails you can unsubscribe from this
list by replying “STOP” to this email.

---|---|---
Maine AFL-CIO spokesperson Andy O'Brien on Tuesday called for the summary execution by firing squad of Democratic politicos who refused to back accused domestic abuser and Democratic U.S. Senate nominee Graham Platner.
According to O'Brien's post, Democratic consultants -- such as the author of a recent op-ed at TheHill.com -- would be "first up against the wall when the revolution comes" -- an overt reference to the kind of violent revolutions that communists and socialists, like Platner and O'Brien, have fantasized about for decades.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/abe17e93-8fe3-4573-8f30-cabcd3428bb3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Prior to embracing the man with the most famous Nazi tattoo in America, O'Brien fashioned himself as an amateur "Nazi hunter," regularly exposing individuals throughout the state who held what he viewed as unsavory or vile opinions.
Now that's he's joined forces with a Totenkopf-bearing communist revolutionary, though, it seems he's developed a taste for the kind of fascistic political violence he once claimed to abhor.
Subscribe to The Robinson Report before the AFL-CIO decides to murder you...

O'Brien's call for the execution of a Democratic consultant came appeared above a link to a Hill opinion piece titled, "I'm a Democratic strategist. I won't stay silent about Graham Platner," written by Democratic strategist Laurie A. Watkins, according to a syndicated listing of the article.
In the visible preview of the article shared by O'Brien, Watkins wrote that she has dedicated much of her career to advancing causes she believes make the country stronger, but that she has never believed a candidate deserves her vote simply because they have a "D" next to their name.
O'Brien's response was not to rebut Watkins' argument, defend Platner's record or grapple with the allegations against him. Instead, the official spokesman for Maine's largest labor federation fantasized about putting a bullet into Democrats who disagree with him.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/94d2a627-613f-41ee-94bc-799483031083?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)| | |

The threat may be more than idle internet posting considering Platner's role in starting and leading the Maine Socialist Rifle Association (SRA), a far left paramilitary group that has posted images of its firing range activities in the past. Those images include at least two that appear to show Platner himself serving as a range officer.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/feed5fc4-9646-4069-b897-b5b2dac0b3e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)| | |

According to the Maine AFL-CIO, O'Brien is the organization's communications director and handles internal and external communications for the union. The AFL-CIO's website also lists him as the contact for press inquiries.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/78adeda4-36f3-4d97-b9d2-19a04ead3010?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
While the AFL-CIO, with O'Brien as figurehead, plays an outsized role in the Maine Democratic Party, the organization is more of a political action committee than a pro-workers' rights group. In Maine, less than seven percent of workers belong to the union, and those numbers have been steadily declining.
The weakness of the AFL-CIO in Maine stems, in part, from the organization of Maine's largest construction firms as employee-owned corporations -- an arrangement that is better and more lucrative for employees and avoids having union dues pay for operatives like O'Brien to publicly screech about murdering heretics.
The comment offers a revealing glimpse into the political culture now surrounding Platner's campaign. For the far left, Platner is not merely a flawed nominee who survived a messy primary. He is a revolutionary vessel. Criticism of him is not just wrong. It is betrayal. And betrayal, in the revolutionary imagination, earns a place against the wall -- that is, a death sentence.
[Share The Robinson Report](https://substack..Vk7x5HwqL6feqnLxLtmOrSFaDyI02RZwHs_bAuVeKNQ?)
Platner's campaign for Senate has been shadowed by a series of scandals, including allegations from a former girlfriend that he repeatedly grabbed her hard enough to leave marks, pulled her from a cab by the wrist and once twisted her arm behind her back and held her in a room.
Platner has denied allegations of domestic abuse. However, he has acknowledged serial infidelity, including via his use of the Kik app -- a chat application that has been dubbed the "predators paradise."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7552547d-7fce-433d-bff1-13b28b26a956?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In his Kik app profile, Platner used a highly sexually suggestive image of himself in a towel. He's said that he only engaged in sexual text messages with half a dozens girls, but they were all over the age of 18.
However, Kik offers no way of verifying ages and Platner hasn't explained how he ensured that his sexually charged chats weren't landing on minors' cell phones.
Republicans who use overheated language are routinely denounced by Maine Democrats, union activists -- with O'Brien among the most vocal cancel culture advocates.
But when a senior spokesman for organized labor talks about lining up Democratic dissenters against a wall, the outrage machine suddenly develops laryngitis.

Those images include at least two that appear to show Platner himself serving as a range officer. | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | Jun 15 | According to the Maine AFL-CIO, O'Brien is the organization's communications director and handles internal and external communications for the union. The AFL-CIO's website also lists him as the contact for press inquiries. | | ---|---|--- While the AFL-CIO, with O'Brien as figurehead, plays an outsized role in the Maine Democratic Party, the organization is more of a political action committee than a pro-workers' rights group. In Maine, less than seven percent of workers belong to the union, and those numbers have been steadily declining. The weakness of the AFL-CIO in Maine stems, in part, from the organization of Maine's largest construction firms as employee-owned corporations -- an arrangement that is better and more lucrative for employees and avoids having union dues pay for operatives like O'Brien to publicly screech about murdering heretics. The comment offers a revealing glimpse into the political culture now surrounding Platner's campaign. For the far left, Platner is not merely a flawed nominee who survived a messy primary. He is a revolutionary vessel. Criticism of him is not just wrong. It is betrayal. And betrayal, in the revolutionary imagination, earns a place against the wall -- that is, a death sentence. ? Platner's campaign for Senate has been shadowed by a series of scandals, including allegations from a former girlfriend that he repeatedly grabbed her hard enough to leave marks, pulled her from a cab by the wrist and once twisted her arm behind her back and held her in a room. Platner has denied allegations of domestic abuse. However, he has acknowledged serial infidelity, including via his use of the Kik app -- a chat application that has been dubbed the "predators paradise." | | ---|---|--- In his Kik app profile, Platner used a highly sexually suggestive image of himself in a towel. He's said that he only engaged in sexual text messages with half a dozens girls, but they were all over the age of 18. However, Kik offers no way of verifying ages and Platner hasn't explained how he ensured that his sexually charged chats weren't landing on minors' cell phones. Republicans who use overheated language are routinely denounced by Maine Democrats, union activists -- with O'Brien among the most vocal cancel culture advocates. But when a senior spokesman for organized labor talks about lining up Democratic dissenters against a wall, the outrage machine suddenly develops laryngitis. Join me up against the wall -- subscribe to The Robinson Report! You 're receiving The Robinson Report for free. 925 West Philly homes and the families who live in them are at risk. Neighborhood Restorations has a contract to keep these houses affordable, but they sent a letter to tenants that would allow them to sell as soon as this July. After that, these units could be sold to private buyers who prioritize profit over families — displacing thousands and driving up rents across West and Southwest Philadelphia.
Housing is a human need, not an investment opportunity for developers. We’re demanding the city and the owner create a plan for permanent affordability — and give tenants the opportunity to buy their homes at below-market rates.

clean_body: | = Hey Peter, Join the hundreds of neighbors who’ve already taken action: | 925 West Philly homes and the families who live in them are at risk. Neighborhood Restorations has a contract to keep these houses affordable, but they sent a letter to tenants that would allow them to sell as soon as this July. After that, these units could be sold to private buyers who prioritize profit over families — displacing thousands and driving up rents across West and Southwest Philadelphia. Housing is a human need, not an investment opportunity for developers. We’re demanding the city and the owner create a plan for permanent affordability — and give tenants the opportunity to buy their homes at below-market rates. If you can, forward this to three friends who care about keeping our neighborhoods stable — every signature matters. You probably know me as the niece of Donald Trump — the twice-impeached, convicted felon who also happens to be President of the United States. I truly believe few people know my uncle better than I do. I’ve watched him lie incessantly, exploit his power, and push this country closer to authoritarianism. Amidst all of the chaos he creates, it’s easy to forget the pain he’s caused, but what scares me even more? He’s not doing any of these things alone. There’s an entire army of MAGA Republicans — in Congress, in statehouses, in places they hope we aren’t paying attention to — working with billionaire donors and Big Oil to drag us backward on everything from the books our kids can read to the air we breathe. And the effects are everywhere. We feel it in the record-breaking heat. We see it in the wildfires, the floods, and the rising toll on frontline communities. And still, too many leaders in Washington act like we have time to spare. **That’s why the work that the Jane Fonda Climate PAC is doing is so important. Their mission is simple: Invest in those leaders brave enough to stand up to polluters, authoritarians, and extremists alike.** These races might not make national headlines, but trust me, they are on the frontlines of the fight for our future. And I’m proud to stand with them. clean_body: I’m turning to you to help us take another step toward forging a future we can be proud of. | = Hey there, it’s Mary Trump. You probably know me as the niece of Donald Trump — the twice-impeached, convicted felon who also happens to be President of the United States. I truly believe few people know my uncle better than I do. I’ve watched him lie incessantly, exploit his power, and push this country closer to authoritarianism. Amidst all of the chaos he creates, it’s easy to forget the pain he’s caused, but what scares me even more? He’s not doing any of these things alone. There’s an entire army of MAGA Republicans — in Congress, in statehouses, in places they hope we aren’t paying attention to — working with billionaire donors and Big Oil to drag us backward on everything from the books our kids can read to the air we breathe. And the effects are everywhere. We feel it in the record-breaking heat. We see it in the wildfires, the floods, and the rising toll on frontline communities. And still, too many leaders in Washington act like we have time to spare. That’s why the work that the Jane Fonda Climate PAC is doing is so important. Their mission is simple: Invest in those leaders brave enough to stand up to polluters, authoritarians, and extremists alike. These races might not make national headlines, but trust me, they are on the frontlines of the fight for our future. And I’m proud to stand with them. This work is powered by ordinary individuals doing extraordinary things. So today, I’m turning to you to help us take another step toward forging a future we can be proud of. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = We’ve seen time and again that candidates who reject Big Oil are the same ones defending reproductive freedom, LGBTQ+ rights, public education, and so much more. It’s up to us, all of us, to meet this moment with the urgency it demands and help elect the next generation of climate leaders. Voters for Tomorrow Action Fund invites you to Building What's Next: A Virtual Power-Building Rally on July 1st from 6:00 to 7:30
PM. This is a rallying call for the next generation of candidates, organizers, campaign staff, volunteers, and movement leaders.

The message is simple: We cannot build the future without people willing to step forward and lead.

Too often, we wait for someone else to run for office, manage a campaign, or organize a community. This event is designed to
challenge that mindset and help you see yourself as part of the solution.

Through stories and conversations with leaders from across the political and advocacy landscape, you will hear why leadership is
accessible, why your voice and lived experience matter, and how you can take the first step.

Featured topics include:

- Why We Can't Wait for Someone Else

- Power Is Built Every Day

- Millennials and Gen Z: The Future Is Already Here

- Your Story Is the Reason We Fight

- What We Owe the Next Generation of Leaders

Date: Tuesday, July 1st

Time: 6:00 - 7:30 PM

Where: Virtual

Seats are limited, so reserve your spot today. Come ready to be inspired, to nominate yourself or someone you believe in, and to
join the Voters for Tomorrow leadership pipeline.

The future is not something that happens to us. It is something we build together.

We refuse to watch from the sidelines.

subject: There’s a reason this story mattered to Charlie
body:
| | | |
---
| | | Fellow Patriot,
---
Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth.

He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him.

body:
**Team Knickerbocker!!**

Independence Day is nearly here! Happy 250th Birthday, America! If you would like to celebrate with other like-minded freedom lovers like us, here is where we'll be and how you can join the fun.

RSVP
For all activities, RSVP by replying to this email. Clearly indicate which activities you are RSVPing for along with a phone number and the number of people you are bringing. I will email additional details to those who RSVP.

July 3rd - Dayton (11:00 AM)

11:00AM - 1:00PM - **Lights in Flight Parade**

Details:
Lineup expected at 11:00AM -11:30AM near St. Clair Street/East 2nd St
12 p.m. – Dayton’s America 250 parade (starts at St. Clair Street/East Second Street, ends at Patterson Boulevard/North Jefferson Street)

July 4th - Centerville (7:30 AM)-> Fairborn (9:30 AM)-> Beavercreek (5:30 PM)

1\. 7:30AM - 8:30AM - **5K Americana Festival**
Do you like to run? Come join this 5K with us - then watch us sprint to our cars to get to Fairborn on time!!!

Details:
Centerville High School

Registration is $40
[Register for the Race!!](https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.americanafestival.org/5k&sa=D&source=calendar&ust=1782389292977374&usg=AOvVaw0A3m_k5tTYXKDJgH1Nh9Xj)

9:30AM - Lineup at Fairborn Plaza
[july_4th_parade_route_map__2025.pdf](https://fairbornoh.myrec.com/documents/july_4th_parade_route_map__2025.pdf)

5:30PM Line up at [Beavercreek High School](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Beavercreek+High+School/@39.7206761,-84.0361435,1012m/data=!3m2!1e3!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x88409bc421ee809d:0x2f2d219290c77dda!8m2!3d39.720672!4d-84.0335686!16zL20vMGY4dmZr?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDYyNC4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)
Parade start at 6:00 PM.

Just like ten years ago, the momentum appears to be on our side.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6532?source=&t=1&akid=1914%2E124072%2E2qC3Ny)
| | | |
---
Peter, we only have one day left until our FEC end-of-quarter deadline – and we’re not where we need to be to reach our $1.5 million goal. I need your help.
**[Can I count on you to donate $5 or whatever you can afford today to help me close the gap and keep up the fight to flip North Carolina’s Senate seat?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk714&amount=5&t=8&akid=1914%2E124072%2E2qC3Ny)**

---
**I want to tell you exactly what’s at stake in this battleground race.
**
It reminds me a great deal of when I first ran for Governor in 2016 – the closest I’ve ever come to losing in North Carolina.

Just like 10 years ago, the momentum appears to be on our side.
Despite the fact that no Democrat has won this Senate seat in nearly two decades, experts are calling our race a “Toss Up.” The New York Times even reports that this is the best chance on the map this cycle for Democrats to flip a red Senate seat blue.

Here’s what worries me ...
**We could’ve just as easily lost in 2016.** That race went to a recount, and despite all of the winds blowing in our favor, we won by only 0.22% of the vote when all was said and done.
That’s why we simply cannot take our foot off the gas. We cannot look at the polls and the predictions and think for a second that we have this in the bag. We cannot give an inch to our Republican opponent or the right-wing super PACs supporting him.
**I won in the same election that President Trump first won the presidency – solely because of grassroots support from people like you. That’s how I intend to win again, so I have to ask:**
**[Please, Peter, will you chip in $5 or more before tomorrow’s public fundraising deadline to help me flip North Carolina blue and retake the Senate for Democrats?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk714&amount=5&t=10&akid=1914%2E124072%2E2qC3Ny)**

Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Friends,
As we approach Independence Day and kick off America’s 250th Birthday celebration, we hope you’ll join Governor Ayotte **THIS SATURDAY** at the Amherst and Merrimack 4th of July parades.
The 4th of July is a time to celebrate the freedoms we cherish, honor those who have defended them, and reflect on the values that make America the greatest nation in the world. As we begin commemorating our nation’s 250th birthday, there is no better way to show our pride in our country and our state than marching together with fellow supporters.
We would love to have you join us as we show our support and celebrate this special day with communities across New Hampshire.
**Amherst 4th of July Parade** 📍 Wilkins Elementary School, 80 Boston Post Road, Amherst🕘 Lineup begins at 9:00 AM
**Merrimack 4th of July Parade** 📍 O’Gara Drive, Merrimack🕛 Lineup begins at 12:00 PM
Whether you can join us for one parade or both, we would be thrilled to have you march alongside Governor Ayotte.
If you would like to attend, please click [HERE](https://us.list-manage.com/LMHgbjuYk1z?e=38cb9f3df0&c2id=d600a7f798f5b28227ceda5411445d39) to RSVP.
We look forward to celebrating Independence Day with you and continuing to keep New Hampshire safe, prosperous, and free.
With gratitude,
Team Kelly

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134270135/630668043/-201694504?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4OWE4ZTNlMy1mMTczLWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gJMjVuv7HRwGaC_edFweoq743aMF2EN7KqnTxtmErIk=&emci=90d4864c-d070-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&emdi=89a8e3e3-f173-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&ceid=9494239)

| | Summer is now here in Northwest Washington. Over the next few months, our team is traveling across Snohomish, Island, San Juan, Skagit, and Whatcom counties to talk with voters. I want to make sure your voices guide the work I do in Congress and inform me on what matters most to the families I represent. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134270136/630668044/1596212816?refcode=2026-06-29-eoq&recurring=&amount=7&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=89a8e3e3-f173-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4OWE4ZTNlMy1mMTczLWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gJMjVuv7HRwGaC_edFweoq743aMF2EN7KqnTxtmErIk=) [**Before our second-quarter deadline, here is a quick look at how I have been working for our region since April:**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134270137/630668045/1596212816?refcode=2026-06-29-eoq&recurring=&amount=7&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=89a8e3e3-f173-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4OWE4ZTNlMy1mMTczLWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gJMjVuv7HRwGaC_edFweoq743aMF2EN7KqnTxtmErIk=)
* **Defending Our Oceans and Coastlines** : We just secured a major victory for our marine ecosystems when the Trump administration attempted to dismantle the Ocean Observatories Initiative and remove critical monitoring equipment from the waters off our coast. Our community pushed back, the administration reversed course, and they will now redeploy those sensors. I will continue fighting for programs such as the Northwest Straits Commission that restore local habitats and protect the natural resources that support our economy.

* **Building Stronger Infrastructure and Good-Paying Jobs** : As the lead Democrat on the House Transportation and Infrastructure Committee, I know that strong local infrastructure creates good-paying jobs and keeps communities connected. That is why I am advancing legislation that will invest more than $580 billion in transportation projects, improve transit systems, restore fish passage by replacing culverts, and train the next generation of skilled workers.

* **Welcoming the World to the Pacific Northwest** : If you know me, you know I am a lifelong soccer fanatic, so I am excited to see the FIFA World Cup underway in Seattle. I was proud to support the bipartisan effort to bring the World Cup to our region and secure the federal investments needed for transportation and security. We get to show the entire world what makes the Pacific Northwest so special, while bringing a massive boost to our local businesses.

clean_body: From ocean protection to the World Cup, our work continues. | | | | Summer is now here in Northwest Washington. Over the next few months, our team is traveling across Snohomish, Island, San Juan, Skagit, and Whatcom counties to talk with voters. I want to make sure your voices guide the work I do in Congress and inform me on what matters most to the families I represent. = = Defending Our Oceans and Coastlines : We just secured a major victory for our marine ecosystems when the Trump administration attempted to dismantle the Ocean Observatories Initiative and remove critical monitoring equipment from the waters off our coast. Our community pushed back, the administration reversed course, and they will now redeploy those sensors. I will continue fighting for programs such as the Northwest Straits Commission that restore local habitats and protect the natural resources that support our economy. Building Stronger Infrastructure and Good-Paying Jobs : As the lead Democrat on the House Transportation and Infrastructure Committee, I know that strong local infrastructure creates good-paying jobs and keeps communities connected. That is why I am advancing legislation that will invest more than $580 billion in transportation projects, improve transit systems, restore fish passage by replacing culverts, and train the next generation of skilled workers. Welcoming the World to the Pacific Northwest : If you know me, you know I am a lifelong soccer fanatic, so I am excited to see the FIFA World Cup underway in Seattle. I was proud to support the bipartisan effort to bring the World Cup to our region and secure the federal investments needed for transportation and security. We get to show the entire world what makes the Pacific Northwest so special, while bringing a massive boost to our local businesses. Whether it is lowering costs for working families, combating fentanyl, strengthening our transportation infrastructure, or bringing federal investments home to Northwest Washington, our priorities come from the conversations we have with you. There is a lot of work ahead this summer, and I am ready to keep delivering the practical, effective representation our district deserves. = = Thank you for your continued partnership. I hope to see you out in the community this summer. subject: My breaking announcement –
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Demand Justice PAC
body:
[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20260629-split.cASlWO&refcode=em20260629-61587&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=61587%2E1407376%2EnVF2ZV ]A picture of Mary Trump.

This is
Mary Trump.

You may know me as the author of Too Much and Never Enough, or as someone
who has spent years sounding the alarm about my uncle, Donald.

[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20260629-split.cASlWO&refcode=em20260629-61587&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=61587%2E1407376%2EnVF2ZV ]I'm launching Transcend PAC to fund the candidates fighting Donald's
corruption every day, who will strengthen the democracy my uncle is trying
to destroy. If you can give, please split a donation between Transcend PAC
and Demand Justice PAC, and then read on to learn why I believe this
moment calls for something transformational.

[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20260629-split.cASlWO&amount=5&refcode=em20260629-61587&t=1003&akid=61587%2E1407376%2EnVF2ZV ]BECOME A FOUNDING DONOR TODAY ››

Here's what I need you to understand about my uncle: Donald is a weak man.

That might seem like an odd thing to say about somebody who holds such a
powerful position, but that's exactly the danger. Every day, as Donald
deteriorates — psychologically, emotionally, and cognitively — he grows
more desperate, increasing the risk to the rest of us.

Strong people do not rig the system in their favor. They don't silence
critics. They don't seek to control the institutions designed to hold them
accountable. Donald does all of those things — because he has to, and he
knows it. His behavior isn't evidence of strength — it's evidence of its
absence.

The comprehensiveness with which Donald and the complicit Republican party
are attempting to dismantle our institutions and take away our rights, in
service to maintaining their hold on power and self-enrichment, should
also make clear what is at stake.

Under Donald’s so-called leadership, the Republicans in Congress have
stood by while our nation’s alliances have become strained; illegal wars
have been started; and our institutions have been weakened and, in some
cases, dismantled entirely.

I believe we are going to prevail. But when corrupt leaders like Donald
and the sycophantic enablers in his inner circle go unchecked or
unchallenged, they can do enormous damage. The antidote is to assemble a
coalition of people who refuse to look away and are willing to take
action.

That’s why I’m launching Transcend PAC. Together, we’ll fund candidates
who believe in public service and who will work to fulfill the promise of
American democracy. Because we deserve representatives who understand
what’s at stake and are prepared to meet the moment.

[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20260629-split.cASlWO&refcode=em20260629-61587&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1004&akid=61587%2E1407376%2EnVF2ZV ]If you're able, please split a donation between Transcend PAC and
Demand Justice PAC today. Your contributions fund organizing,
accountability work, and candidates who understand what’s at stake and are
ready to meet the moment. Every dollar will go toward undoing the damage
my uncle and the Republican Party have done so we, together, can build
something better.

[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20260629-split.cASlWO&amount=5&refcode=em20260629-61587&t=1023&akid=61587%2E1407376%2EnVF2ZV ]Donate $5 ››

Thank you for standing with me,
Mary

name: Voto Latino
subject: SCOTUS Alert: The Supreme Court rejected the Trump-backed effort to eliminate mail-in ballot grace periods
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Voto Latino
body:
We know these attacks aren’t stopping here.
#
Breaking news, Peter:
**Today, the Supreme Court rejected a Trump-backed effort to eliminate mail-in ballot grace periods** — an important safeguard that ensures voters aren’t disenfranchised because of postal delays outside their control.
Think about that for a moment, Peter.
If you mailed your ballot on time, your vote could have been thrown out simply because the Postal Service delivered it a day or two late because of bad weather or other unforeseen circumstances.
That’s exactly what Donald Trump and MAGA Republicans wanted. But they lost. In a 5-4 ruling in _Watson v. RNC,_ this ruling upholds trust in our electoral process and reaffirms that a voter's voice cannot be discarded.
**Peter, but the truth is that this wasn’t just about mail-in ballots. It was another attempt to make voting harder and silence communities whose voices they don’t want to hear for their own political gain.**
Mail-in voting is used by millions of Americans — including our service members abroad, seniors, students, and working families — and every one of their votes deserves to be counted.
And with the midterm elections fast approaching, we know these attacks aren’t stopping here.
**Voto Latino is fighting back by registering eligible Latino voters, protecting voting rights, and ensuring voters in battleground districts can cast their ballots — and we have set a goal to raise $30,000 by midnight tomorrow to scale up our work.**
**[Can you chip in $3 today? With less than 48 hours left, we’re counting on a surge of grassroots support to reach our goal.](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260629-1.61ozN6&amount=3&refcode=em20260629-322&t=1&akid=322%2E1366028%2EI3RBX9)**

Thank you,
Voto Latino

name: Haley Stevens
subject: The MAGA billionaires aren’t messing around. We can’t either.
body:
I didn't enter this race to ask for money, but I need your help today.

| |
---|---|---
| | | Forwarded this email? [Subscribe here](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oYWxleWZvcm1pLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.rrJYdYywj3cdunT1ofMH1VUBwTVV9Ib6yLoOr1NKj0o?) for more

# [The MAGA billionaires aren't messing around. We can't either. ](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=203736143&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjAzNzM2MTQzLCJpYXQiOjE3ODI3NjI4MzgsImV4cCI6MTc4NTM1NDgzOCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.oYTeOyGr1j7GfcuoPrahcYwxkq8ClQLuMcX6TufIUnc)
### I didn't enter this race to ask for money, but I need your help today.
Jun 29
---

---
| | | [](https://substack..Upp99X7lgojLhnaBm_nMeSOaEGS7RaKtlyQrqSK-G3E?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/the-maga-billionaires-arent-messing?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Friends,
Can I be honest with you? Fundraising is probably my least favorite part of the campaign.
I didn't get in this to ask folks for money. **[But I need to ask today](https://substack.com/redirect/71f0998b-ba58-48e7-bc25-fd58bfc339c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , there's too much on the line.
**We need to raise $450,000 before the FEC deadline at the end of the quarter, and right now we 're behind on this goal.**
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/71f0998b-ba58-48e7-bc25-fd58bfc339c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I know "FEC deadline" sounds like some nonsensical Washington-politics-speak. But will you give me a second to explain why it matters?
After midnight on June 30, our donations get tallied up and made public.
That means the media sees them. National Republicans see them. MAGA megadonors see them. And the people deciding whether to invest in this race - or attack us even harder - see them, too.
This deadline is not just about balancing a spreadsheet. It's about showing the world what this whole thing is about: thousands of everyday folks like YOU. The reason I'm running for Senate in the first place.
It's about showing the strength of regular citizens from all over who come together to offer grassroots support. That's what wins races in Michigan.
**At the end of the day, it 's really about whether working families in Michigan have a fighter in their corner in the U.S. Senate - or whether this seat gets handed over to a MAGA Republican backed by out-of-state MAGA billionaires and Donald Trump.**
There has never been a more important moment to support this campaign, because Michigan voters are already receiving their absentee ballots. **[Right now, any donation - big or small - will go further in impacting our campaign.](https://substack.com/redirect/71f0998b-ba58-48e7-bc25-fd58bfc339c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
_I need to be real with you_. I'm not wealthy. Unlike my opponents, I'm not a millionaire.
We already know Mike Rogers is backed by a MAGA Texas oil billionaire who poured $5 million into Michigan. And now the Koch network is gearing up to dump dark money into this race, too.
That's because national Republicans see Michigan as one of their best chances to keep their Senate majority.
They are not messing around. We can't either.
**You are the power of this movement** - the grassroots supporters who care deeply about their communities and their country. That's why I need you to stand with me today.
If you're in a position to chip in today, I'm asking you directly: **[Will you give $20 now to help us close our fundraising gap before our FEC filing at midnight June 30?](https://substack.com/redirect/6141ebaf-3706-44de-a9d0-70cd32775db3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/71f0998b-ba58-48e7-bc25-fd58bfc339c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Help us show the strength of this campaign. Help us prove this seat is not for sale. Help us keep Michigan blue.
With grit and gratitude,
Haley

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/71f0998b-ba58-48e7-bc25-fd58bfc339c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

# The Fight Continues
---
| |
## _Join us this week_
---
| | **Peter,****An exciting week awaits us. After a week filled with candidate forums and events with high-profile Democratic elected officials, we are hearing the same thing over and over: our message is resonating with people. From the Northern Neck to the Richmond suburbs, people are demanding bold, progressive leadership to meet this moment and restore accountability in Washington. But we cannot do that without your help.**
**Election day is five weeks from tomorrow, and we must maximize every opportunity to reach voters over the phone, through the mail, and at their doorstep. We are asking you to be a part of this effort.**
**We are hosting**[**two phone banks this week: Tuesday, 6/30, from 5:30-6:30pm; and Thursday, 7/2, from 6:45-8:00pm.**](https://us.list-manage.com/G3mi10gzRQh?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)****
[**On Friday, July 3rd, we are knocking doors in Glen Allen from 4:00pm-6:15**](https://us.list-manage.com/t2YGDPJvB0s?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**. Our field operations team will be present for training and guidance.**
**We will be traveling throughout the district to celebrate July 4th.**[**From 8:00am-11:00am, we will be in Chesterfield to march in their July 4th parade**](https://us.list-manage.com/1BDkfwtS3mJ?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**. We will be handing out flags, celebrating our country, and sharing Elizabeth’s vision with voters.**
**The afternoon will take us to**[**Colonial Williamsburg, where we will be from 1:45-4:00pm.**](https://us.list-manage.com/ZjIqG131ey3?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**Stop by at any time, say hi, and ask Elizabeth anything!**
**To conclude July 4th, we will be in**[**Historic Williamsburg from 5:00-9:00**](https://us.list-manage.com/FztZG3aUuz3?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**. There will be a concert, food, fireworks, and a community full of patriots committed to restoring the promise of our founders.**
[**On Sunday, we are hosting a postcard writing and pool party in Mechanicsville from 10am-noon**](https://us.list-manage.com/lqE7ZsuPwb4?e=2f83c585b2&c2id=3b13c473c2db4883f0cc0c9f59510326)**. Bring a swimsuit, sunscreen, and your passion for democracy.**
**On Sunday night at 7:00, Elizabeth will be conducting her weekly volunteer briefing on Instagram Live. Make sure to follow @elizabethforvirginia and tune in!**
**For most of this campaign, our grassroots movement was considered a long shot. But now, experienced leaders and organizations are acknowledging the momentum we are building. Every phone call made, every door knocked, and every postcard mailed could be the difference between winning and losing this election. Join us this week to contribute to this movement and build community!**
**—Team Elizabeth.**

Last Thursday, SCOTUS handed the Trump administration a major victory: In a 6-3 decision, the court rejected the claim that the Trump administration had terminated the TPS status of Haitians because of racial biases. In the majority opinion, Justice Samuel Alito wrote that "the current administration, which has terminated every TPS designation that has come up for renewal, simply opposes the TPS program, at least as it has been implemented in the past." The ruling ended the attempt to block the deportation of Haitians, whose 'temporary' protected status had lasted for more than 16 years. The number of TPS protected Haitians arriving in the U.S. has increased dramatically in recent years, largely thanks to former DHS Sec. Alejandro Mayorkas' open border policy.
For Zohran Mamdani and his fellow socialists, the SCOTUS ruling is a tragedy. **[In a video](https://substack.com/redirect/684e5d8a-b9e1-420f-ba09-73287739262a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** released shortly after the ruling was announced, the NYC Mayor claimed that ending TPS for Haitians would put "so many lives in jeopardy." He states that he will stand in solidarity with the Haitians living in New York who might face deportation. While this may sound like a sympathetic left wing talking point, he then goes on to announce that he is willing to "take action" for them. "To have people have their freedom put into jeopardy by the actions of a Supreme Court and federal administrations... it's something that we will not ever accept."

The moderates who have a newfound respect for Mamdani often like to cite his own immigrant status as a reason for why he might be sympathetic to the plights of other immigrants. After all, New York is home to Ellis Island, the immigration processing station that welcomed more than **[12 million](https://substack.com/redirect/024fab41-c10c-43e8-9a7e-fcbb081c30ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** people to America- Perhaps Mamdani is trying to keep its "melting pot" spirit alive, right?
The truth is that the pattern of Haitian illegal immigration is incredibly sinister. The immigrants who passed through Ellis Island did so lawfully while many Haitian immigrants have done so illegally. According to a recent **[DHS report](https://substack.com/redirect/31095d6b-00bf-470a-946b-c09ea0c91162?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , 67,400 Haitian nationals have entered the U.S. between June 2024 and November 2025, with roughly 63,000 of them having no lawful immigration status. One report found that during the first years of the Biden administration, "Haitians were the top nationality for migrants crossing the dangerous Darien Gap between Colombia and Panama, and they have remained among the three largest groups in 2022 and 2023." The Haitian immigrants are also not assimilating in the same way that 19th and 20th century immigrants did. Gang violence is a massive problem in Haiti, with large, armed gangs operating with impunity instead of the country's weak, decentralized government. DHS has apprehended many illegal Haitian gang members for committing violent acts on American soil, such as selling drugs, carrying weapons, and assaulting U.S. citizens. The Haitian culture of violent crime is being carried into our country, and Mamdani wants it to continue in defiance of the federal government.

* * *
* * *
In his response video, Mamdani also claims that New York City has been built by "our Haitian brothers and sisters." This is an outright lie designed to diminish the contributions of European immigrants while exaggerating the role of more recent Haitian arrivals. The Dutch founded New York City in 1624, with waves of hard-working Irish, German, and Jewish immigrants building out the city's infrastructure, turning it into an economic powerhouse. The first accounts of Haitians arriving in New York City come from the **[1950s](https://substack.com/redirect/5947deb1-5097-4a5c-8529-53d398930a7d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , over 320 years after the city was founded. His claim is meant to devalue New York City's history in an attempt to dismantle our governmental system.
Mamdani is a very clever political operator. He uses the left-wing language of inclusivity and solidarity to hide his malicious intentions. When he says that the Haitians have had their "freedom put in jeopardy", he is referring to a liberal theory of freedom that wants to open up borders, break down prison systems, and abolish ICE. Mamdani's "freedom" is contingent on the destruction of American citizenship.

body:
Folks, it’s James Carville.
I’ve worked on more campaigns than I can count, and let me tell you: **I don’t rattle easily.**
But this race in New Hampshire? **It’s TIED. In a dead heat. And that should scare the hell out of every Democrat in the country.**
**[💥 Before you read another word, chip in $10 or whatever you can to help Chris Pappas pull ahead right now.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260629_2.wzF5Jb&refcode=em20260629-2&t=1&akid=7462%2E582294%2EO-hmuu)**

And right now? **This race is neck-and-neck. It could go either way.**
Chris Pappas is our guy. He’s won the toughest district in New Hampshire four times. He knows how to reach voters across the aisle and build a coalition that wins. But he cannot — _CANNOT_ — do this alone.
So here’s what I need from you:
**[Rush a contribution to Chris Pappas today. $10, $25, whatever you can spare to help Chris take the lead and hold the line in New Hampshire.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260629_2.wzF5Jb&refcode=em20260629-2&t=3&akid=7462%2E582294%2EO-hmuu)**

The GOP knows if they take New Hampshire, Democrats don’t have a shot at retaking the Senate. And they’re ready to bury us in negative ads and dark money.
We’ve got to fight smarter, faster, and harder. We’ve got to help Chris Pappas build the campaign we need to win. **Let’s show these Republican bigshots that they can’t buy another Senate seat. Not on our watch.**
**[Give what you can right now.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260629_2.wzF5Jb&refcode=em20260629-2&t=23&akid=7462%2E582294%2EO-hmuu)** Let’s win this damn thing and flip control of the Senate.
